The virtual seismogram estimated from noise correlation functions is decomposed into CWT coefficients at different scales and these coefficients are thresholded at each scale. The threshold value is calculated at every scale using universal threshold method. The enhancement of surface waves present in the virtual seismogram is evaluated by signal to noise ratio (SNR) measurements. The SNR of denoised linearly stacked noise cross-correlations is compared with the SNR of linear and phase weighted stacks of noise cross-correlations.

articleTitle: Nodule Detection in Infrared Thermography Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Imaging is an important tool in the diagnosis of thyroid anomalies and early detection reduces the possibility of cancer stage. Imaging examinations are expensive and frequent exposure can harm the patient. Digital Infrared Thermal Imaging in conjunction with image processing techniques presents a suitable alternative in finding out the thyroid nodules since diseased tissues have high temperature due to large flow of blood as compared to normal tissues that have low temperature. Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) can be used to identify the regions that represent malignant nodules. In this work, a method for the classification of thyroid nodules in infrared thermographic images into benign and malignant classes by using a deep convolutional neural network is presented. The developed Convolutional Neural Network designed for the specific problem has an accuracy of 91.11%. The obtained precision is 0.9167, and a recall value of 0.93076.

articleTitle: Autonomous AI Chat Bot Therapy for Patient with Insomnia
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: This paper’s endeavor is concentrated primarily aiding insomniacs. The importance of accomplishing the work is critical since insomnia is a common sleep condition that stops people from sleeping and therefore is common in today’s society. Because of its chronic nature, insomnia is connected to a considerable deterioration in an individual’s quality of life. The system is powered via Artificial Intelligence and Deep Learning. The goal of this system is to increase the number of encounters with these individuals as they get more sad and anxious. So, essentially, a friendly Chat Bot is created to better understand and treat insomniacs. The algorithm, how it works, and why it has to be implemented are briefly discussed in the paper.

articleTitle: Ensemble Based Feature Selection Technique For Flow Based Intrusion Detection System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: The use of the internet has been drastically increasing in the last decades; hence, network security has become a big issue. To resolve these issues Intrusion detection system (IDS) plays a very important role. IDS detects malicious activity in the network by inspecting all network traffic and sending an alert message or signal to the administrator. So that the person can take the most reliable action to stop or block an attack, by using a higher number of features, we can easily develop an IDS, but it will take more computational time. Hence, it is necessary to choose a relevant set of features from the dataset, which will give us high accuracy and low computational time. In the proposed system CICIDS-2017 dataset is used, and for feature selection, the arithmetic operation is performed on Gain ratio, and Pearson’s correlation. Based on the arithmetic operation result, the top 30 features are selected out of 78 features, and these reduced sets of features are fed to the machine learning classifier random forest, and results are calculated. The result shows that a reduced set of features provides better accuracy, 99.8302%, than the total 78 features.

articleTitle: Reusable Thin Stainless Steel Shadow Mask Fabrication using Electron Discharge Machining
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: A method to fabricate thin stainless steel shadow mask has been presented in this work. A 200 μm thick stainless steel sheet metal has been utilized to fabricate a shadow mask of our interest using Wire-Cut Electron Discharge Machining (EDM). The fabricated mask can be used in any physical vapor deposition (PVD) process for direct deposition of thin film patterns over the given substrate. In this paper thermal evaporation technique is used to fabricate aluminum thin films over flexible polydimethylsiloxane (PDMS) substrates with the developed shadow mask. This method can be used when there is a compromise in size and scale can be tolerated until 200 μm to several millimeter of cutting geometry. Thus, requirement of the complicated and time-consuming procedure of photolithography process can be eliminated to realize a pattern directly over the desired surface. This method also overcomes the issues of shadowing effect compared to the acrylic masks which are usually much thicker and developed using laser cutting method.

articleTitle: Air Pollution Comparison RFM Model Using Machine Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Air pollution is related to the economy in every country nowadays. This research uses Air polluted data set off a month in Seoul, South Korea. According to the Air quality index, the feature provides information on gas sensors Such as Sulfur dioxide (SO2), Nitrogen dioxide(NO2), Ozone (O3), Carbon monoxide(CO), particulate matter PM10, PM2.5, etc. The Air quality monitoring systems have been based on RFM (Recency, Frequency, Monetary) structure in machine learning techniques to predict air pollutants concentration in urban areas. This paper evaluated Air pollution data for different neighbours in clustering values. In data, collect basic information also data inspection has described. Obtaining accurate predictions requires tuning different values from the neighbour of clustering algorithms used in the k-means algorithm. K-means can only utilize when the data objects extend in the Euclidean term. Here dataset performance observes by K-Means clustering with the elbow method in optimal numbers. In the simulation, the correct level of knowledge has been on Air pollution data and higher accuracy—this issue using the tool for analysis with Google co-lab and Python. The cluster value compared with these different types of optima values discussion parts will help plan to execute the predicted machine learning model.

articleTitle: Breast Cancer Prediction by Leveraging Machine Learning and Deep learning Techniques with Different Imaging Modalities
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: The high mortality rate due to breast cancer is a major concern that needs to be addressed critically. Early detection is the most necessary factor in cancer studies. Accurate clinical practice is required which can classify normal breast cells from abnormal cells. This classification requires various approaches in which analysis of imaging modalities and their results needs to be verified. Currently, available screening techniques are analyzed and their challenges and issues are presented. This work investigated some recently proposed approaches for breast cancer detection using Machine Learning (ML) and Deep Learning (DL) techniques and summarizes the contributions to this area. Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) has become a very popular medical images analysis technique due to the accuracy they have achieved in recent studies. This study has attempted to collect and compare the various classifiers used to detect breast cancer. The promising increase in the performance of advanced DL techniques are explored and the challenges and the approaches are discussed. This can result in tremendous improvements in performance and accuracy in the future.

articleTitle: Machine Learning based COVID-19 Mortality Prediction using Common Patient Data
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: COVID-19 was declared a pandemic in 2020, and it caused havoc worldwide. The fact that it is unpredictable adds to its lethality. The world has already seen various COVID-19 infection waves, subsequent waves being even more deadly. Many patients are asymptomatic initially but suddenly develop breathing problems. More than four million people have died due to COVID-19. It is necessary to forecast a patient’s likelihood of dying so that appropriate precautions can be implemented. In this study, a COVID-19 mortality prediction model which uses machine learning is proposed. Most of the current research work requires several patient features and lab test results to predict mortality. However, we suggest a simpler and more efficient technique that relies solely on X-rays and basic patient information such as age and gender. Several ensemble-based models were evaluated and compared using a variety of metrics, and the best method was able to achieve a classification accuracy of 92.6% and AUPRC of 0.95.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Cryptographically Secure Pseudo Random Number Generators for Post Quantum Era
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: The construction of a Pseudo-Random Number Generator (PRNG) is an extremely decisive task in the field of Cryptography, Gaming, Computational statistics, Simulation processes, Gambling, and other fields. But many of the PRNGs are not cryptographically secure so various kinds of models have been presented to generate Pseudo-Random numbers. As generators are used in the field of cryptography too therefore it is inescapable to assess it among scientists and researchers. In this study, we would evaluate different kinds of RNGs against quantum attacks including the one which is based on lattice-based cryptography. In the end, we would contrive to wind up how the lattice-based PRNGS are pragmatic for the Post Quantum Cryptography.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of Compact Slotted Rectangular Microstrip Patch Antenna for 5G Communication Systems Operating at 28 GHz
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: This paper presents two compact-sized rectangular microstrip patch antenna(RMSPA) models with multiple slots for 5G mobile communication applications which require high bandwidth. The radiating elements of the proposed antennas are modified by varying slot arrangements. The resonating frequency of 28GHz, one of the candidates for 5G applications, is considered at which a low atmospheric absorption rate of electromagnetic waves has resulted. The size of the proposed antennas is 7 × 7 × 0.8 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> with a substrate of FR4 material, a relative permittivity of 4.3, and a loss tangent of 0.025. The proposed antennas are simulated using Computer Simulation Technology (CST) Microwave Studio electromagnetic simulator software. For a better bandwidth improvement over the existing designs, multiple slots are inserted and optimized. Additionally, compared to published results the performance of the proposed antennas show improvements in return loss, voltage standing wave ratio(VSWR), and gain.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Standalone DC Microgrid for Different Converter Topologies
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Nowadays, meeting the energy demand of DC loads using a sustainable and reliable system is a significant task. Standalone DC Microgrids is one such system commonly used. An appropriate power converter and controller selection are critical for improving the DC Microgrid reliability. The authors discuss the significance of selecting DC-DC converters in a standalone DC Microgrid. The performance of DC Microgrid with parallel interconnected converters with the droop controller and identical cable resistances is carried out considering boost and SEPIC topologies for the converters separately. Comparison between these two topologies is made based on parameters like load sharing between converters, settling time, and the ripple content of DC bus voltage. The study employs MATLAB/Simulink based simulation. The results indicate the superiority of the SEPIC converter over the Boost Converter.

articleTitle: Length Controllable Literature Summarization Using Transformers
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: This paper defines an approach to implement an output length controllable text summarizer that would help readers and learners understand large chunks of text quickly and efficiently and develop a tool to do the same. It would help and play an important role in revolutionizing today’s education. The approach defined here is a way to better leverage the current state-of-the-art (SOTA) transformer-based models to help achieve length-controllable text summaries from text corpora. The paper introduces an algorithm that, when used in unison with existing transformer-based models, enables the user to specify the required extent of summarization to generate the output summary of the desired length. The approach has been tested on a widely accepted text summarization dataset and gives acceptable ROUGE(45.31) and METEOR(22.16) scores when compared to current state-of-the-art models.

articleTitle: Wind Speed Forecasting using Hybrid Model
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: In the current era of modernization, the technology is moving towards Renewable energy sources over conventional energy sources. To sustain a clean environment the wind and solar power must be integrated into the grid. becomes crucial for the installation and design of wind farms. For designing wind energy systems, the accurate prediction of wind speed is crucial as the load on the grid depends on the wind energy. In this paper, the authors have proposed a hybrid model by combining Auto-Regressive Integrated Moving Average (ARIMA) and Recurrent Neural Network (RNN) - Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) for estimating the wind speed.

articleTitle: Multiband and Multifunctional Microstrip Fed Antenna for WLAN/LTE/X/Ku Band Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: The aim of this paper is to develop a U-shaped microstrip fed structure consisting of an antenna radiator placed above the two ends of the U-shaped structure. The antenna radiators are mirror image of one another where three caterpillar shaped radiating strips are embedded inside the rectangular strip along with G-shaped radiator placed at vertical side. This designed structure produces four resonances at 2.5 GHz, 10.31 GHz, 11.89 GHz and 17.45 GHz to conform the bandwidth requirement and radio frequency (RF) performance including gain, efficiency, radiation patterns to operate smoothly in Wireless Local Area Network (WLAN), Long Term Evolution (LTE), X and Ku band for wireless, radar and video satellite applications, simultaneously. The proposed caterpillar strip antenna demonstrates the simulated impedance bandwidth of 35.55% (2.20 – 3.16 GHz), 22.68% (9.89 – 12.40 GHz) and 25.09% (16.63 – 18.87 GHz) at resonating frequency of 2.5 GHz, merging of two resonances 10.31GHz & 11.89 GHz, and 17.45 GHz, respectively. The proposed caterpillar strip antenna exhibits the RF performance including gain above 2.5dBi, efficiency greater than 75% and omnidirectional farfield patterns in the desired band of operation. Thus, due to low profile 40×40×0.8mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>, economical structure, multiband and multifunctional capabilities in the desired wireless bands, the presented caterpillar strip antenna is good contender to be embedded inside wireless mobile terminals for wireless, radar and video satellite communication and applications.

Author Keywords: G-shaped radiator and U-shaped microstrip fed

articleTitle: Design of an Isolated Bidirectional Active Cell Balancing circuit for Lithium ion batteries
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: The remaining useful life of a lithium ion cell module is determined by its rate of getting charged and discharged. To extend this life, the cell modules need to age uniformly. This aging process is determined by the amount of energy stored in a cell module called state of charge. In order to maintain this state of charge uniformly across cell modules, a cell balancer is needed. This paper proposes a novel active cell balancer that supports bidirectional cell balancing operation with very high efficiency. The active cell balancer is designed using MATLAB/Simulink for a commercially available 14S10P 48V/32Ah battery pack. An overall efficiency of 96.8% is achieved during the cell balancing operation.

articleTitle: Performance evaluation of 2×2 and massive 8×8 MIMO at 28 GHz and 60 GHz for Dhaka City
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Multiple Input Multiple Output (MIMO) is the key technology which enables spatial multiplexing offering higher spectral efficiency and capacity. The assessment of a MIMO channel requires information of the channel matrix parameters such as condition number and rank. Condition number and rank provides information of the quality and capability of spatial multiplexing of a MIMO channel and has been considered as an important and precise mathematical indicator for the evaluation of MIMO channel technology. Besides, 28 GHz and 60 GHz frequency band has also been considered as a potential candidate for mmWave communication. In this paper a 2×2 and massive 8×8 MIMO has been compared in terms of their condition number and rank at both 28GHz and 60GHz considering the environment of Dhaka city. Simulation has been carried out by NYUSIM simulator version 2 and the results have been compared to find out the suitable MIMO configuration and frequency.

articleTitle: Comparison of Hidden Markov Model with other Machine Learning Techniques in Software Defect Prediction
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: In the field of Software Engineering, defect prediction is the most comprehensive and active area of study. It determines which modules are prone to errors and requires rigorous testing. This allows the testing resources to be used effectively while still adhering to the limits. Our project aims to find the model which gives the best results in identifying the defects. We have used the most commonly used machine learning (ML) models K Nearest Neighbours (KNN), Support Vector Machine (SVM), Radial Bias Function (RBF), Decision Tree (DT), Naive Bayes (NB), and the least commonly used model Hidden Markov Model (HMM). The datasets are taken from the NASA and SOFTLAB repository. We have chosen six datasets from the NASA CM1, KC1, JM1, MC1, MW1, and PC1 and four from SOFTLAB AR1, AR3, AR4, and AR5. Principal Component Analysis (PCA) is used to reduce the dimensions of the dataset as there were upto 39 metrics. The best performing model is then determined based on various performance measures including accuracy, precision, F1 score, and recall. Six out of ten datasets showed that SVM performed better than other techniques. HMM performed the best on the AR4 dataset, which had the least data imbalance, and the worst on the AR5 dataset, which had the fewest instances.

articleTitle: An LBT Scheme with Adaptive Freezetime for LAA Outdoor Scenario
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Considering the increasing number of the internet and mobile users, Long Term Evolution (LTE) is being extended to unlicensed band of 5 GHz. Listen-Before-Talk (LBT) is one of the techniques required in many countries for LTE to use the unlicensed band. This paper proposes a scheme for outdoor scenario by adding adaptive freezetime to the LBT. The scheme is evaluated against LBT and WiFi-WiFi scenario. The improved throughput is observed for high, medium and low dense scenarios. The delay is reduced in proposed scheme as compared to LBT for different levels of user densities.

articleTitle: Half Mode SIW Constituted Cavity Backed Dual Frequency Dual Polarized Slot Antenna
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: A dual-frequency dual polarized antenna based on the half mode substrate integrated waveguide (HMSIWG) is investigated and presented for satellite communication. Two orthogonal microstrip feedlines separated by introducing a few shorting vias between them are utilized to excite dual polarization. Initially, two curved-shaped slots-loaded half SIW cavity-backed antenna is analyzed. Subsequently, the curved slots are modified by placing two stubs at the extreme ends to form a novel kind of curved h-shaped slot. These two stubs create two current paths leading to dual-frequency operation. The antenna exhibits isolation of 32.5dB and 24dB at the dual frequencies 11.5GHz and 13.5GHz. The antenna exhibits broadside radiation with a peak realized of 7.8dBi and 6.1dBi at the two working frequencies. The concept of HMSIWG provides the benefits of size miniaturization to almost 50%. The proposed dual polarized antenna serves as a potential candidate for various satellite applications.

articleTitle: Security and Privacy in IoT using Blockchain and Lightweight Cryptographic Protocol
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) has become an emerging topic in the field of digital communication to evolve significantly the modern technologies. To ensure secrecy and privacy of data in IoT applications is the key challenge of this area. To facilitate this enormous challenge, we in detail focus on the security and privacy domain of IoT. By deeply analyzing the challenges in respect of fulfilling the security requirements and protecting the confidential private data, we propose a possible solution to each logical layer of IoT architecture. In addition, we designed the encryption mechanism, decentralizing privacy, secure communication, lightweight cryptographic protocol and demonstration of solutions to all security threats.

articleTitle: Surveillance based Child Kidnap Detection and Prevention Assistance
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: This research paper is based on child kidnap detection and prevention to identify susceptible child kidnap by unauthorized persons. The intelligent surveillance system proposed for this is known as "AICare". The purpose behind developing a proper kidnap detection methodology is to enhance and strengthen the existing child security systems. The key is to identify the main characteristics of a kidnapper in real-time, which follows face recognition, speed detection and object detection theories. Face recognition is used to identify whether the outlined individual has covered his body, especially his face, to hide the true identity, or else the person's face is directly processed for authentication. Speed detection is helpful in calculating movement speed and capturing whether the targeted individual is moving in a hurry. Finally, the stranger is subjected to object detection in order to classify whether he/she is handling a sharp object or not. The captured outcomes are subjected to a decision tree to resolve the person as a kidnapper suspect. The system results in an overall accuracy that is above 90%. As this solution is child-sensitive and responsive, it provides a long term platform that can real-time monitor for potential kidnap based on the kidnapper characteristics to support the working from home parents to take care of their children during crucial times.

articleTitle: Renewable Energy Integrated Charging Stations – A move towards Ecological Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: In current situation, where the supply of conventional resources is on deep reserve, encouraging the renewable energy based e-Mobility systems could be an attractive resolution. With such motivation, this paper proposed a constant DC current charging station which can power electric vehicle (EV) from both conventional and renewable sources. This power circuit integrates resonant convertor and DC-DC convertor in its design, which are two distinctive technologies in industrial applications. A novel π – structured (P2) resonant converter is investigated to provide constant current while a multi level high gain boost converter (HGBC) in closed loop operation controls the magnitude of charging current. Proposed resonant converter (RC) topology has a characteristic feature of drawing less peak current from source and chosen HGBC has two output ports with individual maximum gain of 2 and 50 respectively. This striking feature qualifies the converter for renewable penetration. The system is mathematically analyzed and designed to deliver 1A constant current. A Simulink model is developed to test and validate the system. It is noticed that proposed charger is able to deliver constant current of 1A to any value of load capacitance and is drawing 20% less peak current compared to conventional LCL RC topology.

articleTitle: Advanced Bank Security and Management System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: In the prevailing scenario, Net banking plays an essential role in economic development. However, with the increasing significance of digital versions of banking facilities, frauds and scams are exceptionally rising. Moreover, The existing portal of government banks does not provide complete information to their customers regarding various schemes and investment policies. This paper proposes an upgraded design to the current system. It will make online banking reliable and much more efficient. A verification link is sent via Firebase to gain access to the portal. The user can check his eligibility criteria for various active schemes, insurances, and loan capacity. The portal is integrated with Third-Party Apps to track the IP address and region of the device trying to log in, which is sent along with a verification link when a transaction gets initiated. After verification, the video recording gets initiated and saved in the portal's cloud storage simultaneously. The person's face inducting the payment gets matched with all faces added by the primary user, using Microsoft Azure Face API. On successful recognition, a correct OTP input completes the transaction process. The principal objective of this paper is to provide countermeasures against possible security breaches at several stages. This design will eliminate the possibility of scams to an admirable extent and ensure that the account holders are well aware of the schemes they can apply.

articleTitle: Gene Determination Algorithm: A Blockchain-based Case Study of Crypto Kitties
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Crypto Kitties is one of the most well-known games built on the Ethereum blockchain and has been in operation for a longer time. This paper examines the market’s fairness by focusing on the gene determination algorithm required for breeding two kittens. This method has very little unpredictability, and as a result, players who understand it have a considerable edge over those who do not. Furthermore, this paper demonstrates a methodology that aims to increase randomness in the gene determination algorithm by associating it with a discrete crossover operator. In the end, this paper addresses some of the drawbacks of crypto kitties and countermeasures to overcome them.

articleTitle: Simulation of Shape Memory Wire based Exoskeleton for Flexion and Extension of Upper limb
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: This paper presents the design of an exoskeleton, an assistive device used for enhancing the function of the human body especially limbs. Shape Memory Alloy (SMA) based rehabilitation device that repetitively flexes and extends the elbow joint would improve hand function by improving the mobility and strength of the hand and in turn improves functional ability. This SMA based exoskeleton can be used by patients who are suffering from muscle control disorder and particularly, have lost control of their upper limb. The insights of the design of the exoskeleton for the upper limb (elbow joint) are analyzed for performing flexion-extension movements which are needed as well as necessary for the activities of daily living (ADL) and in turn, can be used for medical rehabilitation.

articleTitle: Motion Anomaly Detection in Surveillance Videos Using Spatial and Temporal Features
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: The problem of anomaly detection is defined as the task of detecting a deviation from usual conformity in a video sequence due to an event, and if such an event is found, determining its start and endpoints. Since anomalies seldom occur in the physical world, most datasets available for anomaly detection consist of only normal activities. In this paper, novel computer vision algorithms using spatial and temporal features to improve detection accuracy is proposed. Further optimizations would be performed by using principal component analysis to reduce the feature dimension. Finally, we would compare our results with existing literature on the Chinese University of Hong kong Avenue (CUHK Avenue) dataset.

articleTitle: To Simulate RAN Slice in 5G Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: In 5G, E2E communications and Network Slicing are some of the crucial components which are being explored more in today’s world to satisfy user needs and requirements by improving throughput and reducing latency. In this paper we mainly focus on network slicing, in that we slice the RAN (Radio Access Network) portion of the 5G network by a powerful emulator called eXP-RAN. We also summarize the different methods used for interacting with eXP-RAN and its emulation. We have created the infrastructure for randomly generated topology. We have emulated this infrastructure for video services.

articleTitle: Machine Learning to Aid in the Process of Disease Detection and Management in Soilless Farming
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: This research aims at enhancing the methods and techniques that are being used in disease detection when it comes to soilless farming. Soilless farming is quite famous among the Sri Lankan farmers farming in urban areas. A mobile application is launched by us and this application is capable of identifying diseases in plants, therefore, farmers do not have to rely on their years of experience to identify the diseases. A novice farmer may struggle to say what is wrong with their plants, while another farmer with many years of experience may say what the disease is with no hesitation. Both those types of farmers benefit from our mobile application equally. The said mobile application consists of four components and each of them focuses on a different service. One of those components is to detect and manage diseases in plant leaves and that component is what this research paper showcases. This particular component allows the user to capture live-images of plant leaves. Then the application processes the captured image to identify if the plant is suffering from a disease. After that, it generates a report with a set of treatments. It further analyses and alerts the user if this disease detected is going to affect the harvest.

articleTitle: Parameter Estimation and Vector Control of Induction Motor using Sciamble Workbench
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Vector control of induction motor (IM) is widely employed in a variety of variable-speed applications drives. In order to use it, the motor parameters must be determined, and the saturation of the machine affects the motor parameters. To achieve good drive performance, IM parameters must be carefully estimated. This paper focuses on the implementation of Vector Control of IM using Workbench Software, when it is operated with FOC strategy. To accomplish torque and flux decoupling in the motor, the rotor's flux vector is locked to dq coordinates, which serve as a reference frame. Workbench Software is a Model and Coding based design platform, which is used for both simulation as well as real time estimation. Simulation results are presented for different reference speeds and variation of load.

articleTitle: Vechicle Counting System in Urban Areas: A Practical Case
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Controlling the vehicular traffic problems has become a priority in modern cities. In this work, a vehicle counting system is presented that quantifies the number of vehicles that travel on a road by means of their detection, using a discipline known as computer vision. The present work describes the details of the implementation of a functional prototype which was developed using the iterative development methodology. Automating the vehicle counting process with a technology of this type allows obtaining more accurate results in a faster and more comfortable way, facilitating the process of decision-making performed by the authorities on subjects of vehicle mobility and city planning.

articleTitle: Design Study of the Spoke Structure for Joint Torque Sensor
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: The joint Torque Sensor is one of the important parts of robotic arm. It helps in measuring the torque experienced in each joint in a robotic arm. The torque on the joints creates tension and compression on the mechanical structure of the sensor. This develops a strain on the sensor structure, and we can measure it using strain gauges. Using the measured strain, we can find the torque applied on the joint. The torque sensor is having an inner hub and outer rim, both are joined using four spokes. Based on the structure of the spoke the strain will vary. If we use a simple cantilever beam as the spoke, the structure may not give higher strain values. So, while designing the sensor, we must make sure that the spoke structure gives maximum and uniform strain over the area where we fix the strain gauge. This paper is discussing the design study of the spoke using Solidworks software.

articleTitle: Efficient 5G Massive MIMO Millimeter Wave 2-tier Network
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: The objective of fifth-generation (5G) era is to thrust ahead of the limits of the previous generation in terms of performance metrics. The millimeter-wave (mmWave) and massive multiple-input-multiple-output (mMIMO) are leading technologies in the directory of the 5G enablers. As the spectrum of the mmWave technology is highly under-utilized therefore, it has the ability to deliver higher data rates through allocating more amount of spectrum. Massive antenna array in massive MIMO offers high multiplexing gains. Therefore, the combination of mMIMO and mmWave technologies can offer a significant increase in the energy and spectral efficiencies, throughput, and capacity of the communication system. This research proposes a system model integrating the capabilities of massive MIMO and mmWave and small-cells to enhance the performance of the system. Further, compared to conventional single-cell systems, a 2-tier network employing small-cells provides more flexibility and better quality of service. However, in such a system cross-tier and co-tier interference becomes a critical issue. This paper also addresses this issue and mitigates the cross-tier and co-tier interference by employing different frequency bands in different tiers of the system. The simulation results show that the proposed system model outperforms the conventional 2-tier system model in terms of spectrum efficiency.

articleTitle: Micro-Seismic Event Detection using statistical feature extraction and machine learning techniques
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a novel methodology for micro-seismic event detection using multiple statistical feature extraction and machine learning techniques. The method is based on amplitude thresholding and is grounded on the idea, that each relevant seismic event crosses a particular threshold value. We have created a unique dataset of movement, hammering and no-movement using off-the-shelve geophones and 16-bit analog to digital converter. The data is sampled at 10000Hz. Each recorded dataset is of duration 2 min. The data recorded is passed through amplitude thresholding method. Multiple statistical features like root mean square, standard deviation, variance, minimum value and maximum value are extracted from the dataset in both time and frequency domain. k-fold cross validation is done to obtain validation accuracy. We have explored various machine learning algorithms and the results are discussed here. Among all classifiers, Random Forest algorithm achieves the overall highest accuracy of 92.76%.

articleTitle: Control of Unmanned Sea Surface Vehicle Using Sliding Mode Controller with Time Delay Control
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: This paper discusses regarding steering and speed control of the Unmanned Sea Surface Vehicle (USSV) using Time delay controller with sliding mode. A Matlab simulation is carried out for the mathematical model of USSV using SMCTDC and results are discussed. It shows that SMC-TDC control can overcome shortcomings in the PID and PD Control which are linear control strategy. Time delay Control is used as an observer, which can take care of uncertainty in the model parameters. USSV autonomous operation can be achieved using SMC-TDC strategy. This strategy can give very good results in the ocean environment and this strategy will take care of all kinds the disturbances acting on the vehicle in the ocean environment. Simulation results are discussed along with the conclusions for each control strategy. This control strategy will be very useful for the USSV developed for defense applications as this control system will take care of the vehicle in the absence of defense personnel.

articleTitle: Video-based Anomalous Activity Detection Using 3D-CNN and Transfer Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Video surveillance is used to observe various behaviour. It is used for security purpose. CCTV cameras are used for detecting the anomaly. The transfer learning is used to detect any unusual behaviour by human. The collected by the CCTV can also be used for detecting anomalous activity from the recorded video. By extracting the features of a target object’s movement and status, and the use of transfer learning helps to recognize activities or unusual action by the human and describe them in natural language.Such a surveillance system can detect, track, and analyse any unusual behaviour of the person in high security needed areas or from the crowded scenes by using video data. Anomaly detection by the visual appearance and motion dynamics of the involved humans and objects in video sequences is explained here with the help of transfer learning.

articleTitle: Prediction of Rainfall in Bangladesh: A Case Study of the Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: The main goal of this paper is to predict rainfall using Regression model of Machine Learning over time series so that steps can be taken beforehand to prevent disasters.The goal of weather forecasting is to provide information to everyone so that they can limit losses and assure safety, which includes life and property safety, as well as human health and wellness.Human eyes can miscalculate a large quantity of data in weather forecasting, causing calculations to go awry. In this paper, a machine learning approach was utilized to enhance accuracy and precision of weather forecasting. The key goal is to create a successful prediction system that can forecast Bangladesh’s rainfall in the coming years. The prediction of rainfall are run on weather data of Bangladesh from 1901 to 2015. By training our system with the collected data and tuning Random Forest Regression, we were able to achieve a 91% accuracy. Following the completion of the architecture, our adjusted model is compared to the base model, Randomized Search CV, using few evaluation metrics such as Mean Absolute Error (MAE), Mean Squared Logarithmic Error (MSLE), Root Mean Squared Logarithmic Error (RMSLE),and the results are quite promising. We can utilize machine learning in field weather forecasting to save lives and safeguard assets.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Dependent DDOS Attack Sensing in Environment of Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: By presenting virtualized with high-demand assets to end applicant having highest dynamicity, lower maintenance efforts, measurable, and decreased finance of infrastructure, Cloud computing became a revolutionary concept in IT technology. Such resources were controlled through various management companies and given across Internet utilizing well knowledgeable rules of networking, formats and standards. Underlying schemes and pre-existing protocols that contains vulnerabilities and bugs which can assist in creating as situation where intrusion become less complicated by adversaries. DDoS (Distributed Denial of Service) kinds of cyber assualt remains as ones of frequently occurring issues which can inflict complicated hazards and influencing performance of clouds. With respect to attack such as DDoS, Adversaries commonly applies unknowingly compromises computers (known ‘zombies’) through extracting benefits of unknown or known vulnerabilities and bugs in sending huge amount of chunks from such already-trapped zombies towards a server systems. These conditions will definitely consumes a large chunk of network bandwidth for communication of victim’s cloud structures or in consuming large time span of servers. Hence, with the concerned research thesis, we calibrated and designed a DDoS sensing mechanism depending on suggested algorithm in replicating DDoS hazard. Such algorithm, combined with signature sensing methods, produces a decision tree in executing autonomous, significant detections of recurring pattern of attacks pertaining to DDoS flooding cyber attack. In validating our system under consideration, we have chosen other techniques of machine learning and relating to generated outcomes.

articleTitle: Road Accident Analysis using Structure from Motion and Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Frequency of accidents have increased along with an increase in the number of vehicles on the roads. Many people suffer injuries, with many incurring a disability as a result of their injury. This work focuses on analyzing road accidents by using machine learning and videogrammetry techniques with the help of videos and images obtained from unmanned aerial vehicles (UAV). Machine learning model involves classifying accident site images into different causes of accidents. Videogrammetry utilizes structure from motion (SFM) techniques to create a point cloud mesh of the captured video.

articleTitle: Emergency Reporting System for Animals
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: This paper aims to connect the missing links with a web-based solution where-in a person, namely the Reporter can register their complaint in about 30-40 words describing the condition of the animal in concern. On finally registering the complaint via our app, each complaint will undergo categorization with the help of Natural Language Processing (NLP). Categorization happens based on the type of animal, the severity of the injury, degree of importance, and a few more important fields to consider after which, all nearby Non- governmental organizations, vets, animal hospitals, shelters and other such Agencies will be alerted of this complaint

articleTitle: Personality Prediction And Group Detection Using Social Media Posts
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Personality is an essential component of our every day life. It has an impact on how we live, speak, respond, and express ourselves, as well as on our mental health. Personality analysis is a natural human ability that is utilised every day with a wide range of individuals and for a wide range of objectives. Personality profiling, in particular, has a wide range of real-world applications, such as mental disease screening exams, human resource interview shortlisting, friend recommendations, and writer recommendations based on the interplay of personalities that people like reading about. Kaggle’s (MBTI) Myers Briggs Personality Type Dataset will be used for the project. The Myers–Briggs Type Indicator (MBTI) is currently widely used and recognised as one of the most reliable instruments. In this work, a comparative study is performed for predicting MBTI personality types using different machine learning algorithm . The results obtained after a series of progressive techniques are compared on the basis of various metrics and the findings reveal that both in terms of accuracy and dependability the performance has been improved as compared to previous works the solution deployment has been detailed, and a large number of feature vector combinations and machine learning models were compared.

articleTitle: A Study on Instability and Parameter Drift in Electric Vehicle Battery Packs
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Lithium-ion battery tends to be the most common choice for the use in hybrid vehicles (HEVs) and Electrical vehicle (EVs) in today’s world because of its high-power density, energy density with overall efficiency compared other conventional cells. However, they too come with their own problems which makes it difficult for end user. Lithiumion cells are prone to temperature changes, overcharging and discharging process. The present condition of the EV application the batteries efficiency deteriorates over period of prolonged usage, as a result it hits the end of life (EOL) earlier than expectedTo avoid such situation, the battery should be monitored in real time for reliability, evaluation and restoration. Battery packs should be analysed and diagnosed with respect to the designed simulation model and experimental model to avoid inconsistency in parametersThis thesis proposes a test model for a lithium Ferro phosphate battery pack that is implemented as both a hardware test rig and a corresponding MATLAB/Simulink model test rig. Two discharging tests known as Continuous Discharging Test (CDT) and Pulse Discharging Test (PDT) is used to test the battery pack to Analyse different parameter related inconsistency between the actual model and designed model

articleTitle: Integration of INS and GPS for Radar Aided Inertial Navigation System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Inertial navigation has been a key element in missile navigation system to achieve positional accuracy with a primary objective to monitor a moving missile state trajectory. Missile motion and its observations can be reflected by mathematical models with adequate accuracy. Inaccurate knowledge of the missile dynamics may cause a particular algorithm to fail miserably. This paper covers the fundamental aspects of KF (Kalman Filter) essential for GPS/INS integration, its mathematical foundations and basic implementation methods. It also presents techniques for sensor integration and how implementation includes its own performance evaluation. Both INS and GPS are different position estimation technologies with their own benefits and drawbacks. An amalgamation of both will provide a optimal navigation /solution with both complementing each other. This research paper carries out an investigation of the performance of an integrated system GPS/INS when changes are made in the algorithm update rate and compare different integration algorithm namely KF and RNN (Recurrent Neural Network).

articleTitle: Robust Controller Design Based on Equivalent Input Disturbance For Magnetic Levitation System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: In this paper, a disturbance rejection robust control design based on Equivalent Input Disturbance (EID) is proposed for the Magnetic Levitation System (Maglev). First, the dynamics of a magnetic levitation system are modelled while significant uncertainties and disturbances are taken into account. The state of the Maglev plant is reconstructed using a state observer. The uncertainty and disturbances are then estimated, a method called the equivalent input disturbance is used. Finally the methods validity is shown by using a magnetic levitation system to control the position of a metal ball. The effectiveness of the EID in estimation of states as well as disturbance rejection is demonstrated through simulation.

articleTitle: Distinguishing pianos: The difference in similarity
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Notating a music piece is not a trivial task. It requires training and experience. This is challenging for new and inexperienced musicians. Automated transcription systems can be very useful in such cases. A piece generally consists of multiple instruments and it is essential to separate them prior to transcription. The challenge aggravates even more when multiple modulations or varieties of the same instrument are present. This is common nowadays and hence, it is essential to distinguish different varieties of the same instrument prior to transcription. In this paper, a line spectral frequency-based technique is used. A highest accuracy of 97.06% was obtained for a dataset composed of 6 different pianos.

articleTitle: PBPK Model Simulation study on Impact of Captrophil for Renal Impairment patients(RI)
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Pharmacokinetic models are computational tools that help in simulating the concentration level of drugs in the blood before real administration. The application of Pharmacokinetic models is abundant in the Pharmaceutical Industries. Physiologically based pharmacokinetic modeling describes the movement of the drug in the body depending on organ blood flow and organ volume. The purpose of this research is to investigate the impact of the drug absorption rate of the drug captopril which is used in the therapy of hypertension and heart failure in Renal Impairment patients (RI) by PBPK modeling (physiologically based pharmacokinetics). This will aid in the evaluation of the clearance of the drug in those with mild, moderate, and severe renal impairment, and to guide dosage recommendations in these people. A simulated AUC ratio from the PBPK model is calculated. The PBPK model was evaluated based on the known anatomy and physiology of the human and other animal species. This method is suitable for dose recommendations in a specific population.

articleTitle: Optimised Smart AI Surveillance in Quantum Computing Age
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: With the advancements in the digital world, crime investigations & video surveillance has also become smart using Artificial Intelligence and IoT like technologies. And the security of the sensitive information transferred between IoT devices only relies on the most robust available classical cryptographic methods. But the prime concern involves the easy breaking of the classical approaches of cryptography soon with the relentless advancement of technology. Thereby, the research mainly focuses on two areas. First, optimising intelligent video surveillance for crime investigations by implementing the ideology of the blockchain, and Deep Learning Neural Networks algorithms for reduced processing yet faster and accurate results. Second, implementation of Quantum Cryptography for better future-proofing and further research for future improvements. The discussion of results shows the optimal usability of deploying this idea and future scopes for improved data security.

articleTitle: STONE: Secret-data Transmission On Novelty Encryption
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: With the increasing growth of the data innovation area, information security has become a critical concern and significant feature. In several confidential applications, it is possible to break the security message. As a result, secret message communication technology is required to avoid message breaches. Steganography is the method of embedding any hidden data or information into a cover file, such as a picture, text, audio, or video. The majority of hidden information concealment methods in the current decade make use of multimedia artefacts. With an in-depth literature review, this paper elaborates on two-stage multimedia steganography. In the first stage, the secret message is implanted in the original sound from a multimedia file, resulting in stego-audio. The second stage embeds stego audio with the video frames once more. To incorporate the hidden audio, the audio steganography employs the 3-bit LSB encryption technique. To the recipient side, the processed video with stego-audio is sent. The audio is derived from the video stream in the receiver part. A concealed message is separated from stego audio using the 3-bit LSB decryption technique. PSNR, SSIM, and MSE metrics are used to evaluate the suggested algorithm's performance. This well-thought-out method has yielded encouraging results.

articleTitle: Effects of Channel Length on 3-D Analytical Compact Model of GAA Multigate based on 30nm Regimes
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: A compact model analysis of GAA multigate in 30nm size is developed by using 3-D poisson equation. From this analysis threshold voltage model has been developed which is derived with the help of center potential. Further, it is observed by reducing the dimension of silicon thickness (t<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">Si</inf>), oxide thickness (t<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">ox</inf>) and drain bias (V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">ds</inf>) respectively, with the variation of different channel length on threshold voltage. The proposed model exhibit increased V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</inf> of 0.33V, declined DIBL of 15.2 mV/V and improved SS slope of 63.56 mV/decade .

articleTitle: Detection of COVID-19 using Wavelet Transform, Machine Learning and Deep Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Since December 2019, the world is fighting against the newly found virus named COVID-19 whose symptoms are closer to pneumonia. Being highly contagious, it has spread all over the world, and hence the World Health Organization has declared this as a global pandemic. Some patients infected with this virus have severe symptoms which are fatal. Hence the early discovery of COVID-19 infected patients is necessary to avoid further community spread. The available tests such as RTPCR and Rapid Antigen Tests are not 100% accurate and do not give quick results either. Therefore, it is the need of the hour to explore identification methodologies that are quick, accurate, and easily scalable. This work intends to do so using different machine learning and deep learning models. First, the step involves feature extraction using Gray Level Co-occurrence Matrix (GLCM) and classification with LightGBM classifier which gives an accuracy of 92.78%. This is then further improved to 95.79% using wavelets. Further, the CNN architectures with max-pooling and DWT layers are compared and it's found that CNN architecture with max-pooling layer gives better accuracy of 95.72%. Thus, this work presents a comparative analysis of Machine Learning Algorithms and CNN architectures for better accuracy and time.

articleTitle: Arrhythmia Classification of ECG Signals Using Undecimated Discrete Wavelet Transform
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Accurate arrhythmia classification of Electrocardiogram (ECG) signals in the initial stages is essential for effective diagnosis. It helps in the prevention of severe cardiac conditions. This has led to extensive research in the development of algorithms for heartbeat detection and real-time cardiac monitoring in recent years. This paper proposes an algorithm for the software analysis and arrhythmia classification of ECG signals. Each signal was decomposed using an Undecimated Discrete Wavelet Transform (UDWT). Further, an approximate version of the ECG waveform was reconstructed using the desired frequency bands, and followed by R-peak detection. Heart rate was estimated for the classification of types of arrhythmias. The UDWT-based technique is advantageous due to its ability to decompose signals at several levels, which can be utilized for various processing purposes. Additionally, it facilitates the simultaneous location of both time and frequency domains. The project work was implemented using MATLAB and SIMULINK. The data records from MIT-BIH and ECG-ID databases were used to test the algorithm.

articleTitle: Design of Detection System using Deep Learning Algorithm for Attack on Network
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: System administrators can use a Network Intrusion Detection System (NIDS) to identify network security breaches in their organisations. Creating a flexible and effective NIDS to protect against unexpected and unanticipated attacks, however, presents numerous obstacles. f-measure values, precision, recall, and precision. For the development of such an efficient and versatile NIDS, We recommend a strategy based on deep learning. With NSL-KDD, a benchmarked dataset regarding penetration of network, Self-taught Learning (STL) is implemented by us, a deep learning-dependent methods. We show the results of our technique and compare them to those of a few previous investigations. The measures studied include accuracy, precision, recall, and f-measure scores.

articleTitle: Trip Planner and Recommender using Flutter and Tensor Flow
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: The topic that has been considered for this project is trip recommender and planner. The principal goal of the project is to develop a mobile application that will give its users customized recommendations according to his or her taste and interests in travel. The main motivation for selecting this idea is that even though the information pertaining to tours or traveling is available all over the internet, where those data are more generic to every user who searches for it. These points of Interests just recommend top preferred places or hotels but does not consider users preference. The preference of specific tourists adheres to their numerous temporal and spatial limitations. One of the alternatives for these issues is to involve tour agencies, but they tend to recommend standard packages which would profit them the most and would not prioritize the user preferences. In recent times, personalization of generic components in life has become a trend, like customizing the way in which searches on google can be made, in the same way, personalizing touring options and its recommendation for a particular person is mostly based on their preferences and time budget constrain in realtime. This application can help people who find it tedious to plan a trip and also execute it. This can make their process of planning and executing their getaway easily. Therefore, this paper mainly focuses on individuals who are in search of personalized tourist routes and plans.

articleTitle: Digitization of Chess Board and Prediction of Next Move
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: In recent years digital technologies and gadgets have grown so much. Along with other things, the field of Artificial Intelligence has also grown dramatically. Computer vision is one of the most compelling types of AI, which everyone must have experienced in one or the other way like in OCR, Image Recognition, object detection, google lens, etc. One might even come to the assumption that given any image or video to a computer, the computer can understand what’s going on in it and can comment a few things on it, just like WE HUMANS. But that assumption is not yet very true. It may be possible in the future but at the present these need some work to become reality. Leveraging this same motivation, we intend to give some contribution for our dream future to become reality. Recognizing and understanding any arbitrary chess board from the image, thereby digitizing it, is the thing that we will be achieving from the proposed system. Along with all that, giving a comment on the current state of chess board, thereby predicting the next optimal move in the game is another thing which is included in proposed system. Think of a human-like robot trying to play chess. Robots must have something like this in order to play the game. In the proposed research work digitization of Chess Board is done by server application from chess board image acquired by user. Current state of the board is generated and sent back as a response to client application. With the help of GUI, the chessboard is generated from the received Forsyth-Edwards Notation (FEN) on the client side. Depending upon blacks turn or whites turn next optimal move to be played is shown to the user. With our proposed system digital instance is generated with accuracy of over 90%. All blank cells of the board are generated with almost 100% accuracy.

articleTitle: Impact of Mole Fraction Variation on the pH Sensing Performance of SiGe channel based Polarity Controllable Ion Sensitive FET – Part-I
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: In this work, a Silicon-Germanium channel-based polarity controllable-ion sensitive FET (SiGe–PC–FET) is introduced which has the capability to detect both H<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup>/ OH<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">–</sup> ions in both of its dual programmable modes i.e., n- and p-mode. In Part-I of the current study, performance of the proposed device has been examined by assessing various characteristics such as energy bands, transfer characteristics, and analysed various sensitivity parameters in terms of threshold voltage and drain current. Further, the effect of mole fraction variation on detection sensitivity and other characteristics have also been investigated. It is seen that due to an increase in Ge content in SiGe, any increase in mole fraction has brought more impact on p- type characteristics in comparison to n-type. It has been demonstrated that proposed pH sensing device operating in n- (p-) mode offers average value of threshold voltage sensitivity as 103.33 (113.89) mV/pH at low (high) value of mole fraction and has surpassed the conventional Nernst limit of 59.3 mV/pH.

articleTitle: Convolutional Neural Network Based Partial Face Detection
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Due to the massive explanation of artificial intelligence, machine learning technology is being used in various areas of our day-to-day life. In the world, there are a lot of scenarios where a simple crime can be prevented before it may even happen or find the person responsible for it. A face is one distinctive feature that we have and can differentiate easily among many other species. But not just different species, it also plays a significant role in determining someone from the same species as us, humans. Regarding this critical feature, a single problem occurs most often nowadays. When the camera is pointed, it cannot detect a person’s face, and it becomes a poor image. On the other hand, where there was a robbery and a security camera installed, the robber’s identity is almost indistinguishable due to the low-quality camera. But just making an excellent algorithm to work and detecting a face reduces the cost of hardware, and it doesn’t cost that much to focus on that area. Facial recognition, widget control, and such can be done by detecting the face correctly. This study aims to create and enhance a machine learning model that correctly recognizes faces. Total 627 Data have been collected from different Bangladeshi people's faces on four angels. In this work, CNN, Harr Cascade, Cascaded CNN, Deep CNN & MTCNN are these five machine learning approaches implemented to get the best accuracy of our dataset. After creating and running the model, Multi-Task Convolutional Neural Network (MTCNN) achieved 96.2% best model accuracy with training data rather than other machine learning models.

articleTitle: A Comparative Review of Expert Systems, Recommender Systems, and Explainable AI
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Previously Expert Systems (ES) dominated Artificial Intelligence (AI) applications and various ES were developed in multiple domains. However, due to knowledge acquisition bottlenecks, these systems fell out of use. With the rise in Machine Learning (ML) and Deep Learning (DL) approaches, another category of systems called Recommender Systems (RS) is now developed for various application domains. As ML/DL systems acted like black boxes, explainable AI (XAI) came into the picture to provide explanations for the recommendations or predictions made. In this paper, we review the architectural similarities and differences between these three approaches along with applications and future directions. It is important to study these to predict the future of RS and any possible resurgence of ES, developments in XAI and application domains.

articleTitle: Cloud Based Effective Health Care Management System With Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Healthcare is quickly becoming the fastest-growing sector because of its extensive coverage, provision of services, and investment by both public and private organizations. In addition, increased life expectancy, improved healthcare for people, and steep reductions in birth rates have left many affluent countries with an elderly population in need of medical care at a critical time. As a result, many health providers are looking for more inventive and cost-effective solutions to address this rising problem to fulfill the increased demand. Cloud computing can provide some of the answers required to solve these issues. To deliver better healthcare facilities, more healthcare firms are embracing cloud-based software and related services. However, designing a cloud-based health service necessitates a thorough understanding of how such services work and the healthcare industry's requirements. This paper discusses formulating a complete healthcare system that incorporates wearable technology and multi-sensor data fusion. The cloud service has sparked a lot of interest from all corners of academia and a wide range of industrial uses. This research also looks at a cloud-based cyber localization algorithm for observing patients that uses smart phones and wearable devices to collect ECG and heart rate monitoring data in an efficient, real-time and scalable manner.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Survey on Ensemble Methods
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Imbalance dataset is one of the challenge in machine learning to predict the correct class and one state of art solution is Ensemble method. Ensemble method predicts the correct class by combining the predictions of several models rather than prediction based on a particular model. The objective of this paper is to review the traditional ensemble methods like Bagging, Boosting and Stacking generalization and their use to handle the current challenges of the imbalanced dataset. We also present and compare of different modification of these traditional technique to address the limitations of these methods like low diversification in Bagging and overfitting in Boosting. We discuss some new directions in the field of classifier ensembles based on a range of recently published studies. A variety of prior theoretical works have been reviewed in the paper in order to provide a deeper insight into the ensembles themselves.

articleTitle: MKRF Stacking-Voting: A Data Mining Technique for Predicting Educational Satisfaction Level of Bangladeshis Student During Pandemic
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Data mining is most efficient when used deliberately to achieve a corporate goal, answer business or research questions, or contribute to a problem-solving solution. Data mining aids in the accurate prediction of outcomes, the recognition of patterns and anomalies, and frequently inform forecasts. Online education is becoming more popular all around the world because of the COVID-19 pandemic. The main goal of this research is to Predict Educational Satisfaction Level of Bangladeshis Students During the Pandemic using data mining approaches by only filling up with some basic questionnaires which are related to the satisfaction level of online education collected through a public survey. By surveying 1004 students from various academic institutions, schools, colleges, and universities on the quality of online education in COVID-19 pandemic scenarios, we were able to determine how productive it would be. Influence how online learning is measured and how satisfied people are with it. To achieve our aim of predicting satisfaction levels, we used a total of eight classifiers, six of which were based classifiers, which we combined with the best three top-scoring classifiers to build a novel ensemble approach called MKRF Stacking and MKRF Voting ensemble classifier. Among those classifiers, the Random Forest classifier outperforms the other six base classifiers with 97.21% accuracy. Our proposed data mining ensemble approaches MKRF Stacking and MKRF Voting outperform applied classifiers. Typically, voting ensemble classifiers outperform voting ensemble classifiers, but in this case, MKRF Stacking defeated MKRF Voting and all applied classifiers with a supreme accuracy of 97.68% (Average). The proposed method would be used in a framework where education counselors find the root causes and minor explanations for dissatisfaction in online education among students so that they can better understand all aspects and provide them with the best advice and solutions to their problems.

articleTitle: Design and Development of Novel Routing Protocols for Ubiquitous Network
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: In this paper, we designed and developed ECA (Event Condition Action) scheme based novel Improved AODV Position and Speed Aware Routing (ECA-IAODV-PSAR) and Improved AODV Edge Connectivity (ECA-IAODV-EC) routing protocols. In specific, these two routing protocols use the speed and position information of the node received from the Global Positioning System (GPS) to deal with routing control packet overhead during inflated mobility. The primary routing protocol ECA-IAODV-PSAR is an alteration of the PSAR routing protocol. The ECA-IAODV-PSAR protocol set limits flooding of the route query packet to the tiny zone of the ubiquitous network to select the optimal route towards the ultimate destination. The results produced in the simulation demonstrate the feasibility of the scheme proposed.

articleTitle: Intelligent Dynamic Routing Decisions in Ubiquitous Network
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: In this article, we designed AODV Route Establishment and Maintenance (AREM) architecture using the Event Condition Action (ECA) scheme to make intelligent routing decisions at runtime. In conventional routing, whenever a node triggers events (for instance, link failure, node disappearance, etc.) source node nullifies the route and provokes the route investigation process again. However, in our proposed architecture, we modified the control packet by incorporating metrics such as bandwidth, processor speed, buffer capacity, and battery power of the node to avoid reinitiation of the route discovery process and select an optimal path from where a route is broken. The proposed architecture discovers the shortest route based on Resourceful Mobile Nodes (RMN) that is an added advantage for rerouting the packets in a critical routing condition and making an intelligent routing decision at runtime. We developed mathematical modeling using the M/M/1 queuing theory concept to investigate intelligent routing decisions in the ubiquitous network. Ultimately, dynamic routing decisions are focused on the approximate time needed for the local memory portion of each mobile node to process ECA rules and the time required for processing ECA rules for the ubiquitous network aspect.

articleTitle: Prediction of Depression, Anxiety and Stress Levels Using Dass-42
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Over the past few decades, many people are suffering from psychological health issues such as anxiety, depression, and stress. It is crucial to detect mental health condition on a timely basis and cure before it turns into a severe problem. In this paper, we analyze the performance of Machine learning (ML) algorithms to predict severity levels of depression, anxiety, and stress (DAS). Severity levels can be measured by the Depression, Anxiety, and Stress Scale (DASS) which consists of a set of questionnaires (DASS42). The intention of this research is to enhance and compare the performance of two different ML algorithms namely Support Vector Machine (SVM) and Logistic Regression (LR) based on classification accuracy with other algorithms. After parameter tuning SVM attains a classification accuracy of 97.35%, 97.49%, and 97.20% for Depression, Anxiety, and Stress. LR attains a classification accuracy of 98.15%, 98.05%, and 98.45% for Depression, Anxiety, and Stress dataset respectively. Parameter tuning is done for SVM and LR to obtain better accuracy with the best suitable parameters, and the results revealed that LR achieved better performance in terms of accuracy compared to SVM.

articleTitle: Analysis of Arrhythmia Classification on ECG Dataset
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: The heart is one of the most vital organs in the human body. It supplies blood and nutrients in other parts of the body. Therefore, maintaining a healthy heart is essential. As a heart disorder, arrhythmia is a condition in which the heart's pumping mechanism becomes aberrant. The Electrocardiogram is used to analyze the arrhythmia problem from the ECG signals because of its fewer difficulties and cheapness. The heart peaks shown in the ECG graph are used to detect heart diseases, and the R peak is used to analyze arrhythmia disease. Arrhythmia is grouped into two groups - Tachycardia and Bradycardia for detection. In this paper, we discussed many different techniques such as Deep CNNs, LSTM, SVM, NN classifier, Wavelet, TQWT, etc., that have been used for detecting arrhythmia using various datasets throughout the previous decade. This work shows the analysis of some arrhythmia classification on the ECG dataset. Here, Data preprocessing, feature extraction, classification processes were applied on most research work and achieved better performance for classifying ECG signals to detect arrhythmia. Automatic arrhythmia detection can help cardiologists make the right decisions immediately to save human life. In addition, this research presents various previous research limitations with some challenges in detecting arrhythmia that will help in future research.

articleTitle: Prevention of DDoS Attacks Targeting Financial Services using Supervised Machine Learning and Stacked LSTM
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Distributed Denial of Service (DDoS) attacks are the most frequent and serious security threats to financial services. It is an attack-type that can be carried out fairly easily with the intention of making the resources unavailable to the users at the required time, but it is very difficult and costly to track and mitigate those attacks. In the recent past, many ISPs have adapted technologies to prevent DDoS at the network level, but they are not able to fully detect and mitigate many of the DDoS attacks as they originate from different types of devices and from several countries. There have also been several research strategies targeting mitigation of DDoS attacks in cloud computing environments, but none of them have tried to specifically target financial services transactions.
