Greeniot is a comprehensive Internet of Things solution to help farmers for execution of agricultural operations in smarter and efficient ways. The high-precision sensors are used to provide proper data for assessing soil quality, detect diseases in plants, predict ambient conditions, sunlight, humidity, moisture, and pH required for production and data driven farming for better crop production and smart use of farming resources. The devices are mapped to the local server and the data is sent to the server. The server can retain the data for some time and then transfers it to the cloud-based platform, which then provides predictive analytics for specific plant and crop models. Using this technique farmers can get all the analytics, insights, and personalized recommendations in layman’s language on a mobile app.

articleTitle: Effect of Substrate Parameters on Coupling in Aperture Coupled Microstrip Antenna
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: The electromagnetic coupling in aperture coupled microstrip antenna (ACMSA) depends on the shape and size of the aperture, patch configuration and feedline structure. However, it also depends on different parameters of a substrate such as thickness, dielectric constant and loss tangent. In this paper, effect of coupling has been studied for four different antenna substrate keeping fixed the parameters of aperture, patch and microstrip feedline. An ACMSA with rectangular patch and rectangular aperture on Rohacell substrate yields highest bandwidth. The antenna has simulated gain of 8.7 dB with the radiation efficiency of more than 83% and bandwidth more than 21%. This antenna is designed at L-band for use in an identification of friend or foe (IFF) system.

articleTitle: Analyzing PTM attack traces through PageDumper: A case study
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Page Table Manipulation (PTM) attack is a type of data only attack that alters memory protection attributes through manipulation of page table data structures. This attack can bypass deployed kernel hardening techniques such as Supervisor Mode Execution Prevention(SMEP) and Write ⊕ Execute (and/or DEP/NX) that are implemented at the page level of abstraction and rely heavily on the integrity of page tables. In turn it enables the attacker to execute code with kernel privileges by disabling memory protection through the manipulation of code pages and/or injection of malicious code. In this paper, we first highlight the impacts of PTM attacks by presenting a case study that bypasses the popular kernel hardening solution SMEP for Linux based systems. Thereafter, we discuss our implementation of an instance of PTM attack, targeting the manipulation of page table attributes. Finally, we present our approach of analysis for the collected PTM attack footprints from runtime system memory using our previously developed tool PageDumper. PageDumper collects such PTM based attack footprints from runtime system memory along with other paging metadata to support an in-depth analysis of Linux volatile memory.

articleTitle: Improved Handwritten Character Recognition for Sinhala Language based on Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Automating handwritten character recognition (HCR) for Sinhalese is still an emerging field, as Sri Lanka is the only country in the world that uses Sinhala as the national language. The Sinhala alphabet includes 60 characters that appear to be fairly complex when compared to many other languages. Although approximately 25 research studies have been conducted since 1990s to recognize handwritten Sinhala characters, there is still a large room for improvement. We have investigated two different methods for handwritten Sinhala character recognition: (i) total pixel length-based method which was newly derived by assuming the differences among characters in pixel length and (ii) Convolution Neural Networks (CNN) based classification, to overcome the limitations in the primitive methods. Multiple preprocessing techniques were used in the pixel length-based method while only a resizing technique was used in the CNN based method. The total pixel length and CNN based methods were tested using a dataset of 55 characters, each with 33 samples. The result of the pixel length method is imperfect as distinct characters may hold the same length. Therefore, we abode this method for further processing in future with more improvements. But the proposed CNN classification produces an accuracy of 85.71% and when compared to current studies, this can be considered as the best result achieved for 55 characters among total 60 characters, with nearly 10% of accuracy improvement.

articleTitle: Compact Design of Microstrip Patch Antenna for 5G Applications Using Millimeter Wave
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: In this paper, a low-profile slotted microstrip patch antenna with an operating bandwidth of 34.093GHz - 38.607GHz has been proposed. The antenna has been simulated using Computer Simulation Technology Microwave Studio (CST MWS), using annealed lossy copper for the ground and patch layers while employing lossy Rogers RT5880 as the dielectric substrate material. Antenna feeding was done through a microstrip line, and a comb-shaped slot was cut out from the conducting patch layer. The simulated results for the design report a return loss of approximately -22.13 dB at the resonant frequency of 37.18 GHz, a main lobe gain of 5.9468 dBi, and efficiency of 84.47%. Additionally, the VSWR value is 1.1698 at the resonant frequency and within the acceptable range of 0 to 2 everywhere else over the working bandwidth. Comparison of the simulation with existing literature suggests that the performance of the proposed antenna achieves the requirements for fifth-generation 5G mobile network applications.

articleTitle: Understanding Higher Education Institution (HEIs) Research Productivity using Clustering and Keywords Network Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Higher Education Institutions (HEIs) in the Philippines are challenged to increase the research output and continue to contribute an idea to the body of knowledge. However, as research outputs are growing, the academic institution is challenged to monitor its theme. The datasets in this study are the published Scopus index paper of Technological Institute of the Philippines (TIP) Manila from the year 2016-2021. This study aims to determine the research themes with Social Network Analysis (SNA) such as betweenness and degree of centrality, and K-means clustering. Keyword networks analysis and K-means clustering techniques successfully unlock hidden growing topics. Most of the growing research themes are image processing, machine learning, deep learning, disaster risk management, environmental sustainability, and computer security. The result of this study particularly research topics can aid research administrators and management in developing policies to increase research productivity.

articleTitle: mGearbox: Condition Based Monitoring of Gearbox in Agricultural Machinery
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: The rapid growth in the world’s energy consumption is leading to the continuous demand for technological advances in the agriculture industry. Recent advancements in intelligent condition-based monitoring systems have gained attention by reducing the repair cost, loss, and probability of injury to the human operator. Classical Machine Learning (ML) and Deep Learning (DL) algorithms have been used for fault detection and diagnosis. However, training these models requires labeled data in a huge quantity. This study develops a fault detection model, mGearbox, by employing the power of the Internet of Things (IoT) and Artificial Intelligence (AI) to alleviate the problem of the unavailability of labeled data in the maintenance of gearbox present in the machines used for agricultural purposes. DL models have the ability to learn complex patterns and perform automatic feature extraction. To verify the efficacy of the proposed approach, the gearbox dataset is investigated and an unsupervised neural network model is built upon Convolutional Reconstruction Auto-Encoder (CRAE). The reconstruction training loss and validation loss are minimized to 0.059 and 0.028 respectively. The results of this experiment show the feasibility and potential of the proposed mGearbox model for fault detection.

articleTitle: Solution of Stochastic Transportation Problem Involving Multi-choice Constraints of Exponential Distribution using Lagrange’s Interpolation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: This paper presents the optimal solution to the transportation problem in which availability and demand constraints are multi-choice parameters and are taken as independent random variables following exponential distribution, containing deterministic cost coefficient and decision variable. For obtaining the most favorable choice from multi-choice parameters, the Lagrange Method of Interpolation has been used. All the probabilistic constraints with their respective probability levels are converted into deterministic ones. To solve the formulated single objective non-linear transportation problem, a Genetic algorithm and NSGA-II based on random sampling are the most effective methods available. One numerical illustration with compared results calculated by genetic algorithm and NSGA-II is given.

articleTitle: Survey of Techniques for Pulmonary Disease Classification using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: The field of medical science is getting more effective with emerging trends of computer science technologies like AI, ML, and DL. The area where these technologies play an important role is the detection or recognition of diseases. This paper discusses existing methodologies and various steps involved in the process of detection/recognition of pulmonary diseases using lung sound. The paper is divided into 4 sections. These sections include general steps of any recognition system using lung sound and study of existing methods. The paper helps to overview the different approaches/experiments and build new and effective ones which can give better accuracy.

articleTitle: Robotic Process Automation for Software Project Management
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: The technology is developing rapidly; people and businesses are using these new trends to make profits. One such trend is Robot Process Automation or RPA, according to Market research future states that many industries will reap the benefits of RPA and it is estimated that there will be a confirm rise for the RPA market with a CAGR (compound annual growth rate) of 29% between 2017-2023. Owing to the pandemic situation in 2020 and 2021 the use of softwares have drastically increased, softwares now a days are getting more and more complex and the time for developing these is comparatively less taking into consideration the competition within the industry. Using robotic process automation in different areas in software project management can help in reducing the time that is required for doing the repetitive tasks and help in increasing efficiency and productivity in the organization. This paper focuses on different areas of software project management where RPA can be used for making the process of software project management more efficient.

articleTitle: MOSFET Based Active Components as Alternative to Passive Counterparts
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: This paper illustrates a compendium analysis of MOS device as replacement of passive elements like resistor, inductor and capacitor. With cadence-based simulations we have demonstrated MOS resistor/active resistor, MOS capacitor/active capacitor, MOS inductor/ active inductor. The simulation results have also indicated that these MOS based active elements have the tuning capabilities. Finally, in the literature review section, the outcomes of several applications have been discussed based on the MOS based active elements.

articleTitle: A Circularly Polarized 2×2 MIMO Antenna with Defected Ground Plane and Reduced Mutual Coupling for Wi-Fi Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: This paper describes the design and construction of an economical circularly polarized 2x2 multiple input multiple output (MIMO) antenna for Wi-Fi applications. The dimension of the antenna measures to 1.3λ x 1.3λ. The antenna consists of a tapered rectangular patch outlined with a U-shaped strip and two inverted L-shaped slots engraved inside the rectangular patch. The designed footprint of the antenna is 1.3λ × 1.3λ, where λ is free space wavelength at 3.68 GHz. The proposed MIMO antenna exhibits circular polarization with an axial ratio of 1.86dB at 3.68GHz and has an impedance bandwidth of 142 MHz (3.62 – 3.76 GHz). The proposed MIMO antenna is constructed on an FR-4 substrate which is cost effective yet efficient for the desired application. The antenna exhibits an average gain of 1.405 dB, efficiency of around 60% and nearly omni directional radiation patterns in the desired band.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of Early Detection System of Breast Cancer Based on Mammogram Images using Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: The uncontrolled and abnormal growth of the cells leads to the formation of the tumor in our human body. Two types of tumor are formed by uncontrolled cell growth. One is benign and malignant. The malignant is the cancerous cell which can spread to the other body parts very easily. When the cells grow uncontrollably in the breast region that can cause the tumor formation in the breast and finally may happens cancer. In today’s world the second most lethal cancer for human is breast cancer. So early detection and diagnosis is very important to reduce the mortality rate. This paper states that we have designed one new system for early detection of breast cancer from mammogram images based on neural network and we have compares the results with various existing methods. We have divide the work into two parts training and testing phase. In the training phase we have used adaptive median filter, Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM) segmentation and Gray-Level Co-Occurrence Matrix (GLCM) features extraction method. We have used the Mammographic Image Analysis Society (MIAS) dataset to train our system then we have taken some testing mammogram images from some local hospitals and use the same pre-processing method. After that we have used probabilistic neural network (PNN) classifier to classify the tumor whether it is benign or malignant and give the desired output with great accuracy.

articleTitle: Circular Slotted Microstrip Patch Antenna for Wireless Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: A slotted circular microstrip patch aerial is formulated for wireless applications with a deficient ground in this paper. More miniaturization is accomplished using slots and defective ground, as well as a wide impedance bandwidth and gain. The simulation and analysis are done to understand the factors of the aerial utilizing the CST (Computer Simulation Technology) Microwave Studio Simulator to acquire the required outcomes. The aerial has a patch area of 78.5 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. The frequency range that was collected for the study was 3.83 – 11.53 GHz. At 4.4 GHz, 7.9 GHz, and 10.25 GHz, the aerial resonates. The bandwidth can be improved by using this antenna. The implied aerial is built on an FR-4 substrate with ambits of 18 * 11 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. In WLAN, X band, and UWB applications, aerial is applicable.

articleTitle: Multiple Bit Error Correction Codes for Memories in Satellites
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: This paper proposes a new Error Correction Code (ECC) for 32-bit memory data named Vertical Parity and Diagonal Hamming (VPDH) Code. It is a linear block code which employs 28 parity bits for a 32-bit data and is represented as (60, 32) code. In this work, the proposed VPDH ECC is compared with Burst Error Correction codes (BEC) and Horizontal-Vertical Parity and Diagonal Hamming (HVPDH) ECC in terms of number of errors corrected, power, delay, area, code rate and bit overhead. VPDH ECC corrects about 30% more 3-bit errors, 24% more 4-bit errors and around 6% more 5-bit errors than HVPDH ECC with the same code rate, power and bit overhead but with a small increase in delay. With the same area and number of parity bits, VPDH ECC offers enhanced error correction capabilities when compared to HVPDH ECC. The VPDH Encoder and Decoder are simulated and synthesized in Xilinx Vivado using a 180nm standard cell library. The design is validated by intelligent test bench automation. Due to its enhanced error correction capabilities, this ECC is therefore ideal for satellite and outer space applications where the on board computers face the issue of soft errors by external cosmic radiations.

articleTitle: Power Quality Improvement of Three-Phase Grid Interfaced WEGS Based on TOFFA Filter
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: For power quality improvement, a third order fundamental filtering approach (TOFFA) is utilized under unusual conditions on a three-phase utility grid, which is connected with a wind energy generation system (WEGS).A TOFFA based filtration technique is designed for fundamental components extraction. Due to nonlinear loads and use of converters, harmonics are injected into the grid. The system's primary goal is to deliver active power to the three-phase grid while reducing power quality concerns such as current harmonics, dc offset inaccuracy, and so on. For maximum power point (MPP) tracking the perturb and observe (P&O) method is used in WEGS. The system behavior is observed under dynamic loading condition and variable wind speed condition on a developed prototype in MATLAB/Simulink. The given system's performance has been determined to be satisfactory with the grid current total harmonics distortion (THD) as per the IEEE 519-2014 standard.

articleTitle: Estimation of Model Order for Low Frequency Oscillations Utilizing Modified ICSS
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Small signal disturbance is one of the problems in present power system network and the effects of the small signal disturbances is the poorly damped low frequency oscillations in power system network. There is a need of detection of these model order to maintain the stability. This paper focuses on a mathematical model based on the sudden change in the variance in sequence using modified integrated cumulative sum of square technique which involves a filtering model based on singular value decomposition and then performing the validation condition using K-medoids clustering to determine the model order which helps in estimation of the lower order frequencies and the damping parameter. It is being demonstrated that the proposed algorithm works even for lower value of signal to noise ratio superimposed in input signals and different PMU reporting rates. This algorithm outperforms in estimating the precise number of model order present in the signal. The robustness and accuracy of the proposed scheme is analyzed on a practical probing real time signals obtained from WECC network and the simulated synthetic signals including the white Gaussian noise. The comparison is performed with several methods for identification of modes at different noise level. Finally, the modes are being analyzed using the rotational in-variance technique based modified TLS-ESPRIT method.

articleTitle: Design and Simulation Modeling of Emergency Transfer (EMTR) System of Electrical Power Supply Network Feeding Nuclear Facility
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: The rapid advancements in nuclear technology has opened gates to many new applications and these require building many nuclear facilities and one of the important requirement to operate such facility is the most reliable power supply system. The paper showers light on understanding the electrical power supply system for a typical nuclear facility that includes four classes of power supplies i.e. Class I, II, III and IV along with emergency transfer system under various failure events. An optimal single line diagram for nuclear facility has been presented for an 11 kV electrical Sub-Station and the vital emergency transfer system schematic has been validated for single line diagram by simulation modeling.

articleTitle: Various Controllers Design for Lime Kiln Unit of Paper Mill
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: All the industrial chemical processes suffer the occurrence of unmeasured & the measured disturbances. An efficient control system is one which nullifies the disturbance effect as early as possible otherwise the developed controller’s performance will undergo a significant fall. In the present research paper, the lime kiln unit of the paper factory is considered. First of all, the ZN based control system is designed to regulate the front end temperature. Then other controllers such as SIMC, fuzzy, and LQG are designed to enhance the control performance. The comparison of all the developed control systems is also highlighted for set-point tracking and disturbance cancellation in this research work. All simulation work has been performed in MATLAB.

articleTitle: Mobile Agent Middleware for Wireless sensor Network in Industrial Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Industry requirement towards automation is consistently increasing. Sensing, acquisition and processing of the data have become the most sought out areas for novel research approaches. In this work, one such potential research problem has been addressed, which is related to the textile industry. The challenge of broken thread detection is consuming more man-power attention and cost. Earlier traditional models such as client-server could not mitigate the challenges of this industry in an effective manner. The proposed mobile agent based sensing and computation paradigm, providing the feasible yet effective solutions for the broken thread detection. In this research work, the mobile agent method using Java Agent Development Framework is implemented. Experimental results proven that mobile agent based methods have potential to detect the broken thread giving better latency and less network load, which are most demanded by the textile industry. Another key inference from the obtained results is with the increase in cluster size, the detection time reduces using this mobile agent based approach. The outcomes of this work are an encouragement to use this mobile agent based method to other industrial applications.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Cooperative Guided Local Search for Solving the Traveling Salesman Problem
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: In this paper, a hybrid cooperative Guided Local Search (GLS) algorithm for solving the Travelling Salesman Problem (TSP) is proposed. The idea of the algorithm is to run a number of agents of GLS and after a number of local search calls, the agents exchange information about their search utilizing the crossover operator to make their further search rational. The partially mapped crossover (PMX) is applied based on the penalty’s values of features to preserve the good components of the best solutions found by the agents during the search. The preliminary experimental results demonstrate that the proposed algorithm is promising and outperforms parallel GLS without collaboration.

articleTitle: Reduced order model based design of linear active disturbance rejection controller with applications
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: This paper presents an improved linear active disturbance rejection control (LADRC) technique. The concept of model order reduction is incorporated in the design of LADRC controllers for the simplification of complex higher order systems, leading to the ease of tuning, simplification of analysis and reduction in the number of controller and observer parameters. The corresponding generalized formulae are derived. The efficacy of the improved LADRC scheme is then demonstrated for the angular position control of a DC servo system by comparing the response with the internal model control technique. It is observed that the desired response specifications are achieved even when the lower order controller is used, thereby revealing the advantages of the proposed technique. Further, the proposed technique exhibits significant improvement in time response over the existing IMC technique. The simulation results provide a validation to the strength of the proposed technique.

articleTitle: Renewable Power System Calculation and Management for Remote Island
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Extensive research is taking place around the world and new technologies are emerging that aim to make people's lives better and easier. Energy can be seen as an essential element for the development of society. People use electricity for a variety of reasons, and the use of electricity is growing by the day. In addition, the use of electricity on a regular basis must be regulated and managed as necessary. In remote island, maximum electricity gets out from using fossil fuel. It is full of renewable energy sources due to the geographic conditions to generate electricity instead of using fossil fuels. The electricity crisis has become a major constraint on continued economic growth, and the remote island energy sector is currently facing serious challenges. Due to the depletion of nature and the energy policy dependent on single fuels, the search for an alternative energy source has become urgent for the country. This study examined how to overcome such a scenario using alternative energy sources such as solar, wind, and hydroelectricity. This study was conducted to assess the optimal feasibility of a grid-connected renewable electricity system in a coastal region of remote island. The design and simulation are operated by the Optimized Mixture of Multiple Energy Sources (HOMER) software to obtain the most economical, the most energy-balanced and the most ecological solution by comparing each model of optimal shape. The HOMER simulation was performed in terms of lowest energy cost, current net cost, short payback period, highest renewable fraction.

articleTitle: Large Scale Predictive Analytics based Real-Time Energy Management and Enhance Power Quality in Smart Grid
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Energy use has increased dramatically in recent years. As the world’s population grows, so does the need for electricity. The LSTM Algorithm is used to anticipate energy management and manage real-time energy in this paper and ANF control algorithm based smart grid to solve power quality issues is investigated in this paper. To maximize both power generations, back-to-back voltage source converters (VSC) are operated with an intelligent ANN controller. Optimal power converters are adopted this proposed methodology and improved overall performance of the system in a acceptable limit. The simulation results are obtained for different mode of smart grid and non-linear fault condition and proven proposed control algorithm works well. The information is presented as data sets. It has been discovered that a significant quantity of energy will be required in the future to train data, depending on the amount of energy consumed in the future. It has the ability to track training progress in real time. In order to forecast future events, this article used 440 daily energy consumption estimates and 250 iterations. MATLAB/Simulink is used to validate the results.

articleTitle: Considerations for the Accurate Design of Impedance Element SAW filters
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Impedance Element RF SAW filters have come to be the mainstay of all modern wireless receivers, including cell phones. The basic performance of these filters is governed by the acoustic response of the constituent resonators. However, there are a host of other secondary factors, viz. impact of resonator pads, interconnecting lines in the filter, grounding connections, housing package parasitics and mounting board layout, that play a significant role in determining the overall response of the filter. This paper, for the first time, presents a comprehensive discussion on the effect of these secondary factors on the final filter response. These factors, when accounted for, enable the accurate design of Impedance Element SAW factors. The findings are exemplified by means of design of a L1 band GPS SAW filter.

articleTitle: Designing and Development of Virtual Power System Analysis Lab for Short Circuit Analysis on Transmission Lines
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: In this Virtual laboratory for ‘Short circuit analysis on transmission lines’ experiment user gets a chance to select appropriate components such as generator or voltage source, three phase transmission line, infinite bus; put values for the modelling of setup exactly as that of laboratory-based setup. This experiment includes remembrance and picturing ability of earlier learnt concepts in Classroom. The user analyses the fault currents and checks the theoretically calculated values in the simulator. After completion of the experimentation, user will be able to validate symmetrical (i. e. three phase) fault current and unsymmetrical (i. e. LL, LG and LLG) fault current with theoretical and experimental values. The user also notices the limitations challenged by laboratory-based setup.

articleTitle: Ensemble Federated Learning for Classifying IoMT Data Streams
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Recent advances in Internet-of-Medical-Things have transformed smart healthcare enabled by artificial intelligence (AI). However, to train classical AI-based machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL) models, patients' data from individual devices, sensors, and wearables must be uploaded to central servers. This is infeasible in realistic healthcare scenarios as it may result in significant security and privacy issues because of the sensitive nature of healthcare data. Federated Learning (FL) is an emerging distributed collaborative AI paradigm that is particularly attractive for smart healthcare. FL coordinates multiple clients (e.g., hospitals, wearable devices) to train the model without sharing raw data. This paper proposed an ensemble federated learning approach for training a deep learning model for classifying decentralized data streams in IoMT environments. The individual federated models are trained locally, and the ensemble learning is carried out on a server. The results demonstrate that the ensemble federated model outperforms the base federated models.

articleTitle: Impact of Mole Fraction Variation on the pH Sensing Performance of SiGe channel based Polarity Controllable Ion Sensitive FET – Part-II
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: In the present study, the efficacy of proposed Silicon-Germanium channel-based polarity controllable-ion sensitive FET (SiGe–PC–FET) is investigated in terms of output drain characteristics, and sensitivity in terms of ratio of ON– state current to OFF– state current and transconductance. Further, the effect of mole fraction on these characteristics has also been accounted. It has been found that for n-mode operation, lower mole fraction (m = 0.1) and for p-mode, higher mole fraction offers superior pH sensing response. Furthermore, at 0.8 V of reference electrode potential, the average value of transconductance sensitivity demonstrated by n- (p-) mode of proposed SiGe–PC–FET is 3.75 x 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−7</sup> (3.24 x 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−6</sup>) S/( μm x pH) for mole fraction value m = 0.1 (0.3) respectively.

articleTitle: Implementation of Android-based Smart Speakers in a Smart Home for Dementia Patients
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Dementia is a broad category of brain diseases that cause long-term and often gradual decrease in the ability to think and remember. It affects the day-to-day activities of a patient. The purpose of our work is to implement a cost-effective, IoT solution for patients suffering with dementia. Our work is a fog computing based implementation of the proposal by Boumpa et.al. [1]. The paper [1] mentions that having an edge/fog architecture could lead to additional requirements for custom-owned platform and design of new smart speakers. In our implementation work, we use android phones as smart speakers. This removes the need of production of new smart speakers and a custom-made platform. Our system is modular and scalable. The data is saved locally owing to privacy requirements. The system helps locate the patient in the house by using the signal strength of Bluetooth Low Energy devices. After triangulating, the speakers play a sound associated with the relative or caretaker, so that the patient can identify the relative. Subsequently, the system also informs the relative of the location of the patient in the house.

articleTitle: Power Loss Minimization in DG allocation using Artificial Intelligent Computing Techniques
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: In this work, evolutionary computation techniques like particle swarm optimization (PSO) and genetic algorithm (GA) are used to access the optimal DG allocation for minimization of power losses to facilitate the extensive integration of DG into distribution systems. The impact of DG integration is accessed to analyse the losses and performance of the system. Soft computing technique PSO is exhibited to be suitable for execution at any type of power system with the specified system bus data and line data. GA and PSO artificial intelligence computational techniques have been modelled and tested on the typical IEEE 30-bus system. Both of the artificial intelligence computational techniques with same control parameters having upper and lower limits have been tested, compared and analysed on the standard IEEE 30-bus test system. The results validate that the appropriate allocation and size of DG are the significant factors that affect the accommodation of the growing levels of DG in distribution networks.

articleTitle: Optimal Quadcopter Placement using Brute Force method for Efficient 5G Communication
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Quadcopters are finding its application in many areas nowadays. Fifth Generation (5G) mobile communication is one area where quadcopters can be made used to assist in providing mobile communication. Quadcopters can be deployed to provide 5G mobile network communication in areas where the network is down due to natural calamities. And there are situations where the network coverage has to be extended temporarily to provide temporary service on demand, for example, when there is an outdoor gathering at a place where mobile network coverage is unavailable. The quadcopters can also be used to assist terrestrial base stations, also called eNodeB, when it is down or overloaded with many users. In all the above cases the quadcopter can be made use of by making it to hover in the dedicated geographical area to provide 5G network service. The ideal height and exact location at which the quadcopter should hover is dependent on the number of users and how they are scattered in the area under consideration. This article focuses on ideal quadcopter placement by finding all the axes in 3 dimension for the quadcopter to hover so that the network coverage and Quality of Service (QoS) to all users is optimal.

articleTitle: Simple Network Simulator: Web based simulator for creating and visualizing Computer Networks and related algorithms
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Network visualization is used widely and the existing network simulators severely are esoteric to intellects that possess a technical understanding of complex programming languages. Simple Network Simulators bridges the prerequisite knowledge gap by facilitating a web interface that demands no setup. It is easy to understand, custom-tailored and requires minimal operating knowledge. This software can be used to simulate concepts involving network protocols, packet sniffing attacks and key exchange algorithms in a visual manner that is simple to comprehend by a dilettante. This simulator also allows tracing of a packet from source to destination using colour marking, so can be used to develop and test new algorithms, and see how they process the packets.

articleTitle: Dimensionality Reduction Techniques to Aid Parallelization of Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: In order to handle the complexity of issues encountered in wireless networking and signal processing, recently researchers have resorted to employing machine learning techniques. This paper proposes the use of dimensionality reduction techniques to aid in the parallelization of machine learning algorithms. For an example use case, we first examine a mode of data parallelism that is based on Radon’s theorem. We then bring out the bottleneck of this scheme in training models on high dimensional datasets and demonstrate the advantage of incorporating dimensionality reduction techniques like principal component analysis (PCA) to improve its performance. We provide theoretical justification for the improvement in the performance. The proposed algorithm was implemented on an NVIDIA GTX 1060 graphics processing unit using PYCUDA python libraries. We evaluate the performance of the proposed algorithm using skin segmentation, HEPMASS, HIGGS and SUSY datasets and bring out the trade off between f-scores and execution time.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of NOMA Techniques under Rayleigh and Rician Fading Channels
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: As today's mobile communication demands the greatest connectivity, high data rates, and low latency, existing multiple access techniques become resource less if new multiple access techniques are not adopted to serve very huge mobile stations in a geographic area. Non Orthogonal Multiple Access (NOMA) is the best multiple access technique to resolve the existing challenges. In this paper, the performance of Non Orthogonal Multiple Access technique in Rayleigh and Rician fading channels is compared. The parameters including Bit Error Rate and Outage probability are considered for the performance analysis.

articleTitle: Adaptive Transmission of Sensitive Information in Online Social Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Nowadays, there is an increase in sensitive data like rumors and private content in popular social media platforms like Twitter. So, it has become a severe issue. To limit the increase of sensitive information there is one approach like restricting the transmission among social network users. Transmission limiting methods, on the other hand, curb the transmission of insensitive data as well which results in poor experiences. To address the challenge of this kind by examining how we can reduce sensitive data dissemination at the same time as maintaining the insensitive data transmission in this research, and create this as a restricted reduction problem to maintain insensitive data transmission as the restraint. Now it is time to investigate this type of problem in the company of all user’s transmission capabilities in a fully known network which is known in advance and with partial users' transmission abilities in a semi known network which is unknown in advance. Now we can cooperatively develop a way out using a bandit framework in a fully known network and semi known network by representing sensitive transmission size as a reward of bandit. Furthermore, In the construction of algorithms it is impossible to define the data dissemination size because of the semi-known network’s uncertain diffusion capabilities. To address the problem, It will be good if we use the bandit framework that helps us to study unfamiliar transmission capabilities through a process of transmission and adjustably perform different measures to restrict the transmission on the basis of transmission capabilities. Extensive tests on natural and artificial datasets show the methods that we use have efficiently constrained sensitive data transmission while achieving forty percent reduction in non-sensitive information transmission loss when compared to four baseline techniques.

articleTitle: Improved Cache Replacement Policy based on Recency Time Re-Reference Interval Prediction
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: The cache memory, having one of the fastest response times in the memory hierarchy (superseded only by processor registers), while also residing closest to the processor, has a major role in improving memory access times. While many different heuristics are involved in improving cache performance, the replacement policy plays a pivotal role. The work presents a novel replacement policy ‘Recency Time Based Re-Reference Interval Prediction’ (RT-RRIP), based on the concept of a recency time prefilter augmenting the performance of the re-reference interval prediction (RRIP) model, resulting in decrease in the number of cache misses and miss latency. An extensive analysis has been carried out using standardized SPEC CPU2006 benchmarks to compare the new policy with existing alternatives. Results reveal that the proposed cache replacement policy RT-RRIP has up to 12% performance improvement over RRIP and 4% performance improvement over LRU on average.

articleTitle: Vector Control of Surface Mounted Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor on Sciamble Workbench
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: PMSMs (Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motors) are used for medium power applications and preferred over conventional motors, such as Asynchronous motors,due to their high performance, efficiency, and controllability. Vector control schemes are used to achieve better dynamic response due to their benefits. Modeling of SPMSM was carried out in dq frame and simulation of the drive system was carried out in MATLAB/Simulink and Workbench Software. Workbench is a Model and Coding based design platform, which is used for both simulation as well as real time estimation. Various simulation results are presented for different load conditions.

articleTitle: Candy Shape Microstrip Patch Antenna for Wireless Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: The antenna configured in this manuscript is a square patch that occupies an area of 144mm2. Aerial is fed by microstrip feed line of 3.6 X 14 mm2 (W X L). Using CST Microwave Studio Suite TM, the structure put forward has been planned as well as discussed. The antenna operates from 3.4 ̢ 9.1 GHz with VSWR ⩽ 2 and gain as 3.9dB. The design of aerial put forward has been made on FR4-epoxy (ε<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">r</inf>= 4.4) substrate with thickness of sheet as 1.59mm. Inside the patch cylindrical slot with inner and outer radius as 3 and 5 mm respectively is done. At 180<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sup> both concentric circles are joined by square patch. Isosceles triangles have been cut inside to achieve better impedance matching. Parametric analysis of the aerial has been done. Patch has low latency, low cost, also has good results in terms of bandwidth, gain, VSWR. It is fit for utilization in WiMAX, IEEE 802.11a WLAN, C band (4-8GHz) and partial S and X bands.

articleTitle: Enhancing Cache Reuse in Gandiva with Literal Parameterisation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Gandiva is an expression compiler for databases using Arrow’s columnar record batch format. It compiles expressions of physical plans to highly optimised native code using LLVM. These native code modules are cached.Our work improves the caching facility of Gandiva and prevents unnecessary recompilation of queries. By templating literals in the generated code, we improve cache performance for complex queries by up to 55%.

articleTitle: Handwriting Slant Determination Using Convolutional Neural Networks and Transfer Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Handwriting slant is one of the major characteristics utilized in forensic handwriting analysis. 1539 handwritten sample images were obtained from the online IAM Handwriting Database and labelled by a forensic expert for handwriting characteristics. Artificial Intelligence based Convolutional Neural Network classifiers were developed for classifying handwriting slant into three classes, viz. left, right and center. Transfer Learning approach from three pre-trained networks VGG16, ResNet50 and MobileNetV2 was attempted but it was found that Transfer Learning did not provide expected advantages, since presumably ImageNet database on which these networks were pre-trained does not have many images of handwritten samples. Therefore, robust and sufficient features could not be extracted using transfer learning approach. For handwriting images, it may be best to go for training from scratch until a pre-trained network which is trained on handwriting samples becomes available. A network trained from scratch using individual sentence images and L2-regularization gave the best performance. With 76% accuracy.

articleTitle: Manhole Depth Analysis and Logistics Planning using TA-Enabled IoT Cloud
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Smart cities have marked an incessant push to modernize technologies for easing citizens. Smarter manholes and planning the associated logistics have become a crucial component for assisting city authorities while coining decisions. This article proposes an automatic manhole depth analysis system using sensors mounted on manhole units. The sensor data collected in cloud services are utilized to schedule logistics using the proposed Threshold Acceptance (TA) algorithm. The algorithm attempts to minimize the distance between manhole operation sites and to improve the cost efficiencies associated with the operations. The proposed method was experimented at the IoT Cloud Research laboratory; the proposed TA-enabled logistics schedule produced a faster logistics plan to rectify manhole issues of streets based on the IoT-enabled monitoring system. The experiments manifested the cost efficiency improvement of over 38 percent and distance efficiency of over 78 percent when compared to the traditional approaches of handling manhole issues.

articleTitle: Skeleton Based Periodicity Analysis of Repetitive Actions
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: This paper investigates the problem of detecting and recognizing repetitive actions performed by a human. Repetitive action analysis play a major role in detecting many behavioral disorders. In this work, we present a robust framework for detecting and recognizing repetitive actions performed by a human subject based on periodic and aperiodic action analysis. Our framework uses focal joints in the human skeleton for the analysis of repetitive actions which are substantiated by the principles of human anatomy and physiology. Using Non-deterministic Finite Automata (NFA) techniques, in this paper, we introduce a novel model to transform repetitive action count to differentiate the periodicity in human action. Experimental results on a dataset consisting of 371 video clips show that our algorithm outperforms the state-of-art (RepNet) [1] in simultaneous multiple repetitive action counts. Further, while the proposed model and RepNet give comparable results in counting periodic repetitive actions, our model performance surpass RepNet significantly on analysing non-periodic repetitive behavior.

articleTitle: Analysis of GNSS Trans-ionospheric signals for identification of Ionospheric Scintillations
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)

authors.preferredName: V. B. S. Srilatha Indira Dutt

abstract: Navigation systems like IRNSS/GPS/SBAS play an influential part in accurately determining user position. Ionospheric irregularities will deteriorate the Navigation information, radio propagation and effects the Trans-ionospheric communications of the radio waves. Therefore, such irregularities are the most troubling factors for Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS) users. Thus, characterization, prediction and detection of ionospheric irregularities have turned into crucial investigation obstacles exclusively in the vicinity of low latitudes. In this work, the compression rate of change of total electron content index (ROTI) and amplitude scintillation index (S<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf>) are computed and analyzed for a day long data to identify the ionospheric irregularities.

articleTitle: Impact of Vertically Graded (VGrad) Channel Design on Device Performance of β-Ga2O3 MOSFET
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: In this paper, the impact of graded doping in vertical direction in the channel of Ga<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> MOSFET has been proposed with the aim of improvement in Baliga’s Figure of Merit (BFoM) to enhance the device suitability for high voltage applications. Various DC characteristics have been analyzed using ATLAS-2D simulator and a comparison with the conventional Ga<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> MOSFET has also been carried out. It is demonstrated that the proposed device offers higher breakdown voltage and significant improvement in BFoM with slight increment in ON-state resistance.

articleTitle: Bimodal Stress Tracking via Voice and Heart Rate
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Stress remains a concern for the majority of the planet’s population. Its adverse effects are widely studied, well-documented, and universally experienced. There has been a significant increase in academic interest towards stress and health tracking through more mobile means, given the proliferation of mobile devices and their applications, specifically through wearable means. This burst of interest has generated many different approaches, multimodal stress analysis amongst the many ones. However, not all avenues of tracking stress have been adequately explored.In this paper, the team outlines the framework for an application that uses a hitherto unseen approach to tracking personal stress levels: a bimodal approach considering biometric physiological indicators via wearable photoplethysmography (PPG) sensors, as well as audio data including elements of voice tonality indicators such as pitch and loudness on phone calls to evaluate stress levels of subjects

articleTitle: Hand Gesture Interpretation Model for Indian Sign Language using Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Exchange of words among the community is one of the essential mediums of survival. Besides that, as claimed by the World Health Organization in 2021 over 5% of the world population suffers from speech impairments, they are lacking the basic prerequisite that is needed for the survival of the human race. These people communicate using "Sign Language" among their communities which has its meaning, grammar, and lexicons, and it may not be comprehensible for every other individual. Our proposed methodology focuses on creating a vision-based prototype that interprets the Indian sign language into understandable speech or text on an embedded device and this is done using deep learning technique which is an advanced extension of machine learning technology. our model makes use of an integrated webcam for capturing the real-time hand gestures and a Raspberry Pi to process the collected samples. The model uses a dataset that has 1200 images for every gesture for better results. Training data and test data have been partitioned into 9:1 ratio. This work involves CNN, IoT, and Python Language.

articleTitle: An Advanced Model Regarding the Impact of Cyber-Attacks on Power System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: This paper proposes an advanced model for investigating the impact of cyber-attacks on power system in terms of frequency disturbances and voltage disruption during changing the load, called as ICAPS. The proposed ICAPS model is formulated by five different controllers, such as, LFC, AGC, AGC-PID, AVR and AVR-PID that are implemented in two sets of system model. Specifically, a stable limit of the speed regulation of LFC, integral controller gain of AGC, and amplifier gain of AVR are determined from their characteristic equations derived from Routh-Hurwitz array, while the Proportional-Integral-Derivative (PID) controller gains for AGC-PID and AVR-PID are determined using the tuning process. The key aspect of this paper is to obtain the impact of cyber-attacks on power system in terms of frequency disturbances and voltage disruptions during changing the load. According to our knowledge, no one has considered before about these issues at a time. In order to evaluate the proposed ICAPS model how does it work, a series of experiments was conducted using MATLAB Simulink tool. The simulation results are presented in this paper in terms of frequency deviation and voltage disruption (i.e., positive and negative biased cyber-attack) and oscillations of the system. Finally, the most severe attack is successfully identified in this model from the simulation results to prevent the power system from unstable conditions.

articleTitle: Enhancement of Voltage Profile/Stability by Optimal Placement of UPFC
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: In the growing power sector, voltage profile and stability are the two parameters that are most critical. More and more use of inductive loads at the receiving end decreases the power factor and deteriorates the voltage profile of the overall system. When the reactive loading increases the voltage at the receiving end decreases and thus the need of reactive compensation increases. In this paper the weakest buses have been found depending on the loading capability using Fast Voltage Stability Index (FVSI) and Line Stability index (LSI) and then for improving the voltage profile at the weakest buses after increasing loading, UPFC is used and the results are observed. The test systems used are IEEE-14, 30, 57 bus systems and one practical 62 bus Indian Utility system.

articleTitle: PCA-LSTM: Deep Learning Approach for the Indian Large-Caps
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: This paper focuses on developing an algorithm for trading in the Indian stock market which outperforms the benchmark strategy. We used technical indicators as our input to predict the price using LSTM which averts multicollinearity within the indicators using PCA. The model was built on the Indian index, NIFTY50 and was selected on mean squared error of the scaled predicted prices, accuracy of signals generated, and annual profits compared to the buy and hold strategy. We also compared the PCA-LSTM model to the classical LSTM model. It was then applied to the 50 stocks which constituted the index to develop an optimized portfolio by maximizing the Sharpe ratio and minimizing the risk using the efficient frontier method. Our objective is to create a model that could answer three major questions - what to trade, how much to trade, and when to trade.

articleTitle: Control of DC Microgrid using Interconnection and Damping Assignment Passivity based control method
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: This paper proposes the use of Interconnection and Damping Assignment Passivity Based Control (IDA-PBC) technique to control the DC microgrid. The IDA-PBC method improves the damping of the system. It also ensures asymptotic stability of the system. It is achieved by making the system passive. The islanded DC microgrid design structure used in this study consists of a photovoltaic source, battery and a DC load connected to a DC bus. The main objective of this method is to derive a control law that will provide stability of the DC bus voltage. The control law is derived using IDA-PBC method and implemented in SIMULINK. In the simulated model, the irradiation is varied and the load is kept constant. The simulated response shows that despite the variation of irradiation, the bus voltage and the power drawn by the load remains constant. It also gives the optimum irradiation value for which the battery contribution is negligible. It can be used for efficient battery management and to increase the battery life.

articleTitle: Small-Scale Hybrid Solar and Wind Power Generation System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: The importance of renewable power generation is taking a major role in present research work. The consumption of energy has spiked and significant changes in technology have taken place in the last half a century. Perhaps some of the most futuristic and important developments to have happened over this period are in the energy sector, where number of energy resources have been detected, from which renewable energy can be harnessed. The leading two forms of non-conventional energy perhaps are Solar Energy and Wind energy. In this paper, a hardware model for harnessing small scale power generation from both solar and wind system is designed and developed.

articleTitle: Economic Order Quantity Model of Deteriorating Items Under Trade Credit Policy : A Game Theoretical Approach
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: This study presents economic order quantity model using Game theoretical approach. Here, we have considered a classical Manufacturer and Retailer Model where Manufacturer as well as retailer are considered as two players. The main focus of both the players is to minimize their costs. Both of them agree to maintain Optimality principle of Nash equilibrium when they interact between them. So, our work is based on two-player non-zero-sum game which is a non-cooperative game. Concept of Trade credit is also used in this study where relaxation times of supplier to retailer and retailer to customer is to be calculated. To get the Nash equilibria of this model some optimization with respect to game theoretical approach are applied. The problem is solved with the use of non-linear optimization technique –GRG (LINGO-13.0) and exemplified with some mathematical data. A number of particular cases are consequent and the results are vacant in both table and diagrammatic forms. Lastly, a numerical example is taken under consideration to exemplify hypothetical outcomes and a sensitivity analysis of parameters on the solutions is conducted.

articleTitle: Transient Analysis of Doubly Fed Induction Generator in Grid Connected Mode
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: In this paper wind energy conversion systems (WECS) is getting more attention to diversify the increased renewable energy penetration. DFIG has emerged as a preferred choice for WECS due to capability for reactive power control and variable speed operation with lower rating of power converters. In this research a comprehensive grid-connected of DFIG system wind turbine in a dq-frame has been developed in TYPHOON HIL and MATLAB software platforms. The results are come by in different fault scenarios and results are compared. With increased penetration of renewable distributed energy generations WECS are getting more attention from industry and researchers.

articleTitle: 5G Context Prioritized Core Slice
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Apart from what is already there, 4th Mobile Communications Generation, the 5th Mobile Network Generation (5G) introduces the next generation of mobile telephony standards. The 5G system will provide speeds of more than 10 Gbps. As a result, only a few main issues must be resolved in order to achieve this extraordinary rate. However, in order to attain this super speed, a high-frequency wave must be used to transfer data over a larger bandwidth.While network slicing in mobile networks is enabled by technologies such as Network Function Virtualization (NFV) and Software-Defined Networking (SDN), effective Core slice mangers in the 5G system remains a significant challenge in terms of improving connectivity system throughput, communication overhead, and interoperability for each of these anticipated services. We focus on the Core core network monitoring and management of network slices across numerous locations using a single management and contrapuntal entity with a consistent proof of concept. We also go over the various methods/approaches to improve network performance, network security, and network orchestration.Based on the analysis performed with the proposed system, we were able to determine how latency, throughput, and bandwidth utilization change as the number of clients and base stations change.

articleTitle: Design of Deep Neural Network based Anomaly Detection System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: A novel anomaly detection-based NIDS is main Demand in the computer networking security for discriminating Malicious software attack at the early stage. It monitors and Analyzes network traffics, checking abnormal behaviors or attack Signatures. Unknown Attacks need high detection rates and accuracy in network intrusion detection models. With software defined networking, deep neural networks (DNN) can identify anomalies. The dropout method prevents overfitting DNN models. About six characteristics have data. The NSL-KDD dataset was used to fit and assess the flow. These data attributes allow the model to be excellent generative and perform well on intrusion recognition using a fraction of the data. Lessons learned from cross-entropy loss function with SoftMax output layer Five class labels are covered by two distributions, one normal and two assaults (Dos, R2L, U2L and Probe). Accuracy is a model performance statistic. A 92.65% accuracy rate is promising.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Hardware Accelerator Unit
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: As Moore's Law slows down, there is increasing interest in the use of hardware accelerators, especially for ML / Big Data workloads. Industrial examples include Google's Tensor Processing Units and the recent Inferentia from Amazon. This design is the DLAU (Deep LearningAccelerator Unit) which is a scalable architecture which employs Deep Learning algorithms (Restricted Boltzmann machine). The Deep Learning Accelerator Unit employs three units that employ tiling techniques. The first block is the Tiled Matrix Multiplication Unit (TMMU), Part Sum Accumulation Unit (PSAU) is the second unit and the last unit is the Activation Function Acceleration Unit (AFAU). These individual units work together as a cohesive unit to enhance the acceleration process, thereby improving computation speeds as the final target of this work.

articleTitle: Smart Story Telling Model with Emotion-Based Enunciation and an Interactive Query Resolver
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Emotion detection from text is a field of research that involves the recognition of emotions such as anger, disgust, fear, happiness, sadness, and surprise from text. The conversion of text to audio with enunciation based on the detected emotions from text is a contemporary field of study that has short explorations done. The paper presents a methodology and design to classify the emotional affinity of sentences in the narrative domain of children’s fairytales using a transformer-based natural language processing technique called the BERT model for subsequent usage in the appropriate expressive rendering of text to speech synthesis using statistical models. The paper also presents a methodology to implement a question-answering system to resolve queries regarding the story by producing an audio clip containing the most appropriate answer extracted through a natural language processing technique called the ALBERT model. The model developed can detect emotions from text with an accuracy of 83%, convert text to audio with emotion-based enunciation with an accuracy of 90%, and the question-answering system produces an accuracy of 80%. The future work will focus on increasing the features taken into consideration for manipulating neutral audio. Detection of sarcasm and handling of complex sentences having multiple emotions will also be included.

articleTitle: Identification of Fraudulent Credit Card transactions using Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Ever since the existence of e commerce payments systems came into being, people have found new ways to access someone’s credentials illegally. This is a major issue in current era as more and more transactions are being done online. Every year fraud cost generated in the economy is more than $4 trillion internationally. This is not surprising, as the return on investment for fraud detection and prevention is massive. Cybercrime specialists estimate that an investment of 1 million dollars into fraud or attack can net up to$100 million. Financial institutions such as commercial and investment banks operations are increasingly being targeted and require some method to handle and support the progress of credit card fraud detection. To avoid fraud and to secure transactions systems they require some advanced technology that support the use of artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) approaches to stay one step ahead of criminals. Being a classification type problem, we propose a ML model incorporating XGBoost algorithm along with SMOTE analysis. Our aim is to minimize the number of fraudulent transactions being predicted as legitimate transactions as the gravity of these type of errors outweighs that of the other in a real world scenario.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Real Time Radar Data Transmission System utilizing MATLAB
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: The primary goal of this paper is to incorporate information of multiple Radar and view it cumulatively in a typical Graphical User Interface(GUI) Radar scope. The frame work of this paper has been created using the data of DPR 886. The system was designed considering two stations under the same local network. After the acquisition of Radar crude information, it was reconstructed, filtered using Butterworth and Median filter, and then processed and formatted in MATLAB. The formatted information was sent from server to client and afterward rearranged and reformatted again in client side. The process has been completed using TCP/IP and WebSocket in MATLAB. The idea is unique in the field of Radar and thus no previous work has been done before as per the knowledge of the author. This paper will help to empower distinctive military branches to effectively partake in observation and surveillance of threatening targets remotely without really being available in the Radar base.

articleTitle: A Survey on Automated Skin Lesion Segmentation and Classification of Granular Parakeratosis
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Analyzing skin lesion images through manual and visual inspection is bit difficult in diagnosing skin diseases. This visual analysis of lesion images is very time consuming and cumbersome. Earlier, most of the research concentrates only on melanoma but there are yet other skin diseases to be considered. One of the diseases is Granular parakeratosis. It is a type of skin disease that is characterized by brown or red keratotic papules that combine to form plaques. The important steps in Computer-Aided Diagnosis (CAD) systems are lesion segmentation and classification. The role of lesion segmentation and classification in medical image processing is to enhance the quality of features extracted from a skin lesion. The advancements in machine learning have reduced the rate of misclassifying the lesions. Hence, it is necessary to have an imaging diagnosis system that can detect skin diseases early. In this paper, a review of some of the techniques used in detecting melanoma is presented to determine the technique best suitable for segmentation and classification of granular parakeratosis. Here, the discussion about how Convolutional Neural Networks have been used in identifying the lesion, the algorithms implemented and efficiency of the methods are presented. The other related issues such as data collection and evaluation metrics have been discussed. After a detailed review, it is found that U-net with binary cross entropy can be chosen as the best method for segmentation and SVM for classification of granular parakeratosis.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of 1-Bit Full Adder CMOS Using Bridge Style Logic
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: This paper presents the new design of CD logic based style named as Bride Logic style. Low power consumption with high performance of the circuit is one of the important factors for VLSI circuit design. The bridge logic style makes it reliable and accurate for performing complicated logic expressions. Bridge logic style uses the less number of transistors count as compared to others logic style. In this logic style, the output is pre evaluated before the input is given to pull down network. The timing window technique is analyzed which is mainly for the reduction of power dissipation i.e., reduction of the evaluation time Simulation results of Bridge logic illustrate the superiority against the conventional logic design in terms of power consumption. Area, Number of transistors count, Delay, PDP. We have performed simulation using 90nm gpdk CMOS Technology in Cadence Virtuoso.

articleTitle: Advancement in Agronomy Using Machine Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Agronomy is the science of dealing with the distribution, management, and productivity of agricultural land. When living in a country where agriculture is the heart of the economy and people’s lifestyle, agronomy and the development in agronomy becomes a major responsibility of IT sectors to seek enhancement in existing technologies. All the factors of agronomy are so much dependent on rainfall in India, where unpredictability of monsoon and uneven distribution of rainfall leaves us with the next best option - Irrigation! The key aspect of this paper is to select best suitable solutions from the major irrigation systems namely drip irrigation, surface irrigation, sprinkler irrigation and sub-surface irrigation. Machine learning comes to rescue as the model is trained with thousands of samples of data along with the best irrigation system suitable for respective location. The location of a farm or field is selected using illustrator nominator wherein appropriate crop recommendation report can be generated to improve the productivity using machine learning algorithms. Thus, machine learning is on its way to help the farmers to adapt suitable system according to their requirements.

articleTitle: PFC of SI-SEPIC Converter Cascaded with Flyback Converter for EV Application
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: This paper presents the control and modelling of an EV charger. The proposed EV charger consists of two-stage power conversion, the initial stage consists of SI-SEPIC converter, which inherently provides the power factor correction of the EV charger at the source, and the later consists of Fly back converter. Collective combination of these two converters for the EV charger results for the operation of converter at reduced duty ratio resulting which efficiency of the converter is increased. This work mainly focuses on designing the components of the converter and power factor correction using PWM and SPWM controller techniques in MATLAB environment.

articleTitle: Functionalised Biosensor for Diagnostics of Dengue NS1 Antigen : An Integrated Approach Towards Device Development
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Dengue, which is one of the rapidly spreading disease, through mosquitoes as carriers, poses challenges to biosensor developers, since the detection has to be rapid and very specific. A non-invasive microwave-based complementary split ring resonator (CSRR) sensor is proposed to detect the dengue NS1 antigen. An electronic antenna structure is etched out of copper, on the ground plane of a micro-strip or transmission line using a printed circuit board (PCB) method on the FR4 substrate. A micro-strip transmission line coupled with CSRR acts as a sensor whose sensing mechanism is based on the interception of the electromagnetic field around the resonator, which leads to a shift in the resonance frequency. To detect dengue NS1 antigen, the sensor is functionalized with the antibody of NS1 using 1-(3- dimethylaminopropyl)- 3-ethylcarbodiimide hydrochloride (EDC) as the linker molecule. Upon immobilizing NS1 antibody on the CSRR structure, the sensor offers high sensitivity in the form of a change in the power of the signal due to antigen-antibody interaction. The sensor shows a power shift of ~24dB for 10 μl of dengue NS1 antigen. A highly sensitive sensor is hence demonstrated using careful simulation studies, electronic device development and use of nanotechnology for improved performance.

articleTitle: Automatic News Summarizer Using TextRank
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Natural Language Processing and Deep Learning have made it possible for machines to understand the text. This is accomplished by comprehending the interrelationships between words and sentences. In this modern era, everyone wants to stay abreast of the latest news but the overwhelming amount of information makes it difficult for one to keep track of the status quo. Hence, we propose a fast summarizer system, with the help of which people can get a glimpse of source-based news summaries. In this system, we extract news from 250 sources and provide them to the user in the form of summaries, which aid in getting a quick overview of the news articles. News is provided in a categorized way where the user can select his favorite new sources. Our system not only effectively summarizes the news articles but also uses caching to ensure faster retrieval and a good user experience. We have chosen a production-efficient algorithm to get quick summaries.

articleTitle: Investigating Liquid Permeation and Drying Behaviour of Silicone Rubber Nanocomposites for High Voltage Insulation Structures
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: The present work investigates the percentage weight change in alumina tri-hydrate (ATH) and boron nitride (BN) doped room temperature vulcanized (RTV) silicone rubber (SiR) nanocomposites during the absorption process when dipped in acidic nitric acid solution. Applicability of the Fickian and Langmuir diffusion model was tested for the obtained diffusion data and the results were analyzed using the same. Further, the air-drying behaviour of the nanocomposites was also monitored. The dependency of liquid absorption and drying on filler weight percentage (1%, 3%, 5%, 7%, and 10%) is reported.
