The combined effect of liquid permeation and air drying in weight change of SiR nanocomposites specimens was analyzed Finally, the optimized nanocomposite formulation with the best resistance against liquid permeation induced insulation degradation is suggested.

articleTitle: Dynamic Vehicular Diagnostic Tool for Identifying Random Errors & Real-Time Solution Providers using Android Based Multi-Variant End User Profiles
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Due to underwhelming growth towards road side assistance have exponential increased the difficulties and inconsistency in providing the vehicles, road side assistance in an adequate manner. Hence, a new approach is a need of the hour. In these paper we discuss about the Android platform based solution to mitigate the under lying problem in service providence for road side assistance.The lack of a proper assistance system for people who become stranded on the road with vehicular difficulty and are unable to find help is a looming issue in the near future. Android is the go-to platform for the majority of people, hence, making an Android-based system to build a network of competent professional service providers to give speedy assistance is a necessary tool for everyone who wants to drive their car anywhere without hesitation. The system validates the service providers, and their information is saved for user reference, providing high-quality and safe services. The system, which has a minimalist layout, provides a clean, straightforward, and efficient interface for consumers to seek help quickly. Despite the fact that there are several roadside assistance teams, they exclusively provide service in well-developed cities. This leaves a large chunk of the country unrepresented. Creating a nationwide network of service providers allows customers to receive reliable assistance anywhere and at any time.

articleTitle: Automatic Self Calibrated Measurement System Using 3D Modelling
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: The growing era of digitization and automation of the apparel industry offers massive opportunities to improvise upon the traditional methods. The design process is a fundamental and preliminary action amongst a series of merchandise manufacturing processes. The designs obtained via customer interaction must be accurate and precise enough to acquire a satisfactory end product. To achieve the required precision of the perfect fit attires at an affordable price, one must be able to measure themselves from time to time and hence need a quick and comprehensive tool to do this with ease. In this paper, an approach is proposed that automates the measurement process bypassing the human involvement of the tailor to obtain measurements swiftly. An object is detected from the input followed by key-point detection and instance segmentation. After instance segmentation, a 3D model is generated using deep learning and machine learning techniques like Convolutional Neural Networks, 3D Reconstruction. The system takes input as an image or a video, analyses the 2D and 3D forms of measurements from the input, and finally outputs the required set of precise measurements from the respective input. The results obtained by this method are more accurate compared to traditional methods of measurement.

articleTitle: Modeling and Predicting the COVID-19 Trajectory in India
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: The SARS-CoV-2 has a confirmed case count of about 11.3 million and a death count of about 158,000 in India as of March 13<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup>, 2021. Despite the early social distancing and lockdown measures imposed by the government, these counts have continued to rise. Mathematical models prove extremely useful to predict the course of the pandemic and for the government to strategize accordingly. Over due course several models have emerged to predict the number of COVID-19 cases, but a thorough comparison among them is lacking. In this paper, we propose three novel Hybrid Models based on the compartment-based modeling over data from January 22<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">nd</sup>, 2020 to December 3<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">rd</sup> 2020 and then make comparisons among them and show through experiments that each performs a better fitting and prediction on the Johns Hopkins COVID-19 dataset pertaining to India than all other benchmark models discussed. Comparison of our proposed Hybrid models with the existing compartment models like SIR, SIRD and SEIRD demonstrates that our proposed Hybrid models not only overcome the performance inefficiencies related to the existing compartmental models but also achieve a better fitting on the Johns Hopkins COVID-19 dataset.

articleTitle: Performance Comparison of Polygonal Loop Frequency Selective Surfaces for Band Stop Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: This paper investigates the performance of different polygon geometries of loop frequency selective surfaces (FSS). Various polygon shapes such as triangle, pentagon, hexagon, heptagon, octagon, nonagon, decagon, and circle of FSS, are analyzed and compared using results obtained from software-based simulation. It is observed that the bandwidth of band-stop response and band-stop frequency improves as the number of edges increases in the polygon. The paper exhibits that the bandwidth of the band stop response can be tuned by choosing a suitable polygonal design of FSS.

articleTitle: Recovering 3D from 2D Image Points (Calibrated Camera Approach for Surveillance)
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Video cameras are being installed, both indoor and outdoor, for surveillance of critical installations to detect intrusions and suspicious actions. The 2D pixel location of the intrusions (e.g. humans, car etc.) in the scene can be detected using foreground extraction techniques or using deep learning based object detection models in the form of bounding-boxes. Since, these optical video cameras acquires only a 2D view of the scene (perspective projection), the physical dimensions of these intrusions in the scene and their location in 3D space are lost. Recovering this 3D information of the intrusions(objects) will certainly enhance the surveillance. Many computer vision techniques are available to obtain the 3D information from 2D images under Photogrammetry like calibrated stereo imaging, structure from motion etc. Currently, few deep learning based models are also being researched to extract 3D from single 2D images. In this paper, we propose a new methodology to obtain 3D information of the objects in the scene, which is suitable for surveillance applications. This methodology uses a calibrated single camera under an assumption that object-of-interest is standing on (known)ground plane. These recovered 3D points can be used readily in existing surveillance systems. We apply this methodology to three surveillance scenarios in this paper. The recovered 3D points are used 1) to estimate the intrusion location and dimensions 2) to detect abandoned baggage and identify possible owner 3) to detect physical-distance-norm violation in a crowded area.

articleTitle: Ml-Powered Cache Replacement Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: The literature survey prospects complete theory of cache replacement algorithm, ranging from requirement of cache memory to the current cache replacement algorithms and the future of artificial intelligence in revolutionizing the field of computer architecture. The research paper discusses about requirement of cache and its working. The paper covers the important parameter which were used to train the model. The algorithms are then compared based on Eviction rate. After the comparison of models we discuss the future implication of the topic concluding the result in the last section.

articleTitle: Digital Implementation of Pulse Compression Algorithm for Multifunction Radars
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 7th International conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Pulse compression techniques are essential in modern day radars to achieve desired range with required resolution and lesser peak power. Pulse compression technique use matched filtering to compress the echo pulse at receive. Further windowing techniques are used with the pulse compression coefficients to attain low side lobe levels at the output so that weaker targets don’t get masked. This work presents a digital implementation of the pulse compression technique comprising of computation of pulse compression coefficients, system message decoding and parameter extraction, matched filter and weighted filter implementation using digital means for functional requirements of radar. The work presents the design stages in detail with implementation optimization and modeling results presented for each stage. The design has been implemented for multi bandwidth, pulse width, slope parameters and results are presented. Further the design is configurable for different modulations as per the need of the radar.
